He was one of the less cold-hearted members of the DA-5 group, made by Dr. Iris, and is yet another a modified human. He is currently residing with Takeo and M-21 in Frankenstein's residence and is also working as a security guard in Ye Ran High School. He is "Number One" of the RK-4 which is a group of four formed by himself.

Takeo (Kor. 타키오) was once a member of the DA-5 created by Dr. Aris. Believing that his sister was held captive by the Union, he participated in its experiments and followed orders in order to protect her.    ~!In Chapter 151, however, it is revealed that this is a ruse concocted by Dr. Aris, who created the facade for the sake of her own entertainment. Takeo is later invited to live in Frankenstein's house after betraying the Union and erasing all traces of his and Tao's existence, which resulted in the Union's belief of their failure and death as experiments. Recently, both he and Tao have asked Frankenstein to enhance their powers in order to increase their capability to protect their comrades, especially M-21, with whom they have formed a strong bond of loyalty and friendship. He is a member of the RK-4 and his codename is 'Number Two'. !~ (Source: Noblesse Wikia)

Han Shin-Woo, a student in Ye Ran High School, popular because of his excellent martial skills. On the day of Rai's awakening, he happens to meet him on the way to school and gradually becomes close to Rai at school, developing a bond which can be termed as friendship. Eventually he gets involved in many strange fights against people with extra-ordinary powers. Rai and Frankenstein rescues him and others from the mess everytime. Later he as well as the others are brainwashed for their own safety and so remember nothing of the strange happenings.  Shin-Woo is an energetic and athletic teenager with bright red hair. He is always seen with a bandage over the bridge of his nose. He is actually pretty good looking but not that many people realize it because of his behavior.  He is well-known within the city to be skilled in martial arts and feared by gangs. Shin-Woo is often shown sleeping (and drooling) in class and slacking off. Though he is shown as a lazy student, he is also very courageous and would protect his friends at all costs. He often tends to be late for school due to over sleeping. He has liked Yuna for a long time and it is disclosed that he confessed to her in past which led to an embarrassing situation. Since then they have been just good friends although Shin-Woo still has a liking for Yuna. Shin-Woo is also starting to like Seira.  Shin-Woo is an amazing Martial Artist excelling in Tae Kwon Do and Hapkido. He is well-known within the city to be skilled in martial arts and is feared by gangs. He is able to match the powers of M-24's Infected, and since then has been getting stronger.  Even for normal human parameters, it's been quoted that Shin-Woo possesses an incredible amount of strength, which he has displayed during his multiple battles; including those with the Infected.  It's been noted that one of Shin-Woo's most incredible atributes is his speed, shown as he instantly disappeared when he went to aid Yuna right after she yelled for help. Alongside his speed, his agility and reflexes have incresed during the progression of the series; to the point he was able to dodge one of Shark's attacks and counterattack at the same time.  Shin-Woo's most incredible strength relies in his durability, since he is able to endure attacks that would normaly kill a human being; as shown when he took a beating from Shark and was even able to stood up against him one more time right after he threatened to kill his friends.

(Source: Nobelesse wiki)

alternative: レジス・K・ランデグル

characters.description: Regis is a young noble. His caretaker is his companion Seira. Regis has high regard for elegance and is extremely prideful. He values manners and honor primarily. He and Seira appeared to investigate the possible appearance of an infected/mutant amongst the humans.  Regis is fairly short and when Ikhan first sees him, he becomes excited at having someone the same size as him. Ikhan has always felt self-conscious, but Regis does not feel bothered by his height.   ~! His grandfather is an old well-respected noble called Gejutel and also the current leader of the Landegre clan. It is revealed Regis father died in the rebellion and betrayal against the Lord.!~  He does not get along well M-21, especially when they first met because he has a strong dislike of modified humans who he thinks sold their humanity for power. However, once he sees how M-21 sacrifices himself for the children he reconsiders his opinion of him, but not enough to fix their "sensitive" relationship.  Against his will and better judgment, Regis gets recruited into Tao's group, Rai's Knights, as RK No. 3.

Age: unknown (>500) Race: Noble Occupation: Kertia clan leader Eye colour: Red Hair colour: Blonde Rajak is the head of the house of Kertia, a clan of murderers, and Rael’s older brother. His soul weapon is Kartas and it takes the form of two daggers, the same as his younger brother’s soul weapon Grandia. Since Rael also has a soul weapon without being the clan leader, Rajak’s soul weapon is incomplete. Initially, it was assumed by Rael that Rajak didn’t know about this, but later it is revealed that he knew. Unlike Rael, he has impressive control over his soul weapon and uses it to hide his aura. This way he can be discreet like a true assassin. He can also create multiple copies of himself to surround the enemy. Combined with his hidden aura and enhanced speed, it is extremely hard for his enemy to know who’s the real Rajak and where the attack will come from. Rajak moves with an air of dignity. When he is ordered by the Lord to go to the human world to bring Seira back, he feels somewhat irritated. Being convinced by his younger brother that the work doesn’t suit his dignity, he lets Rael do it instead of him. When Rai manages to move past him, he couldn’t believe someone overstepped him. He is very loyal to the Lord and executes anything he has been bidden to do without question. He also shows great respect to the other clan leaders and scolds Rael when he insults Gejutel. He executes his job as a clan leader whole-heartedly. When Rael manages to wound Frankenstein during a fight with Rajak by using a sneak attack, Rajak slashed himself to compensate for his brother’s foul play.  Source: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noblesse_(manga) http://noblesse.wikia.com/wiki/Noblesse_Wiki

__Race:__ Noble
__Occupation:__ Lord of the Nobles

Raskreia is the current leader of the Nobles and her soul weapon is Ragnarok. She is the daughter of the previous lord who entered the eternal sleep 500 years ago. Unlike her predecessor, she is more strict and conventional, showing an arrogant and sever attitude. However, according to Gejutel, she is too sentimental in her decisions and this is one of the reasons why she is considered unfit to be Lord by the so-called traitors.   ~!Rai and Frankenstein are acquainted with her, but they’re not on friendly terms. Before the previous Lord’s eternal sleep, some of the clan leaders made excuses and didn’t enter the eternal sleep with him. The previous Lord agreed with their request, but as soon as he entered the eternal sleep they betrayed him. Therefore Raskreia holds a grudge against the traitors and she claims that Rai was the one responsible for the betrayal against the former Lord. However after facing Rai and receiving his incomplete Ragnarok, she discovers that Rai has been asleep for 820 years. Rai’s arrival triggers a message from the previous Lord in which he explains he wanted his daughter to embrace freedom rather than carry the heavy burdens the Lord has to face. After hearing that, she has the feeling she doesn’t really deserve Rai’s Ragnarok, so she doesn’t accept it because she thinks she needs to earn it. This triggers a new message from the previous Lord in which he praises her because she made an important decision when not accepting Rai’s offer.!~

(Sources: Wikipedia and Noblesse Wiki)

Age: unknown (>500) Race: Noble Occupation: Kertia clan member Eye colour: Red Hair colour: Blonde Rael is very skinny, has a pale skin and is good-looking. He is Rajak’s ambitious younger brother. Even though he is not the Kertia clan leader, his father gave him an imperfect soul weapon, Grandia, which takes the form of two daggers. He displays a harsh nature and dislikes humans to the point he needs to restrain himself not to kill them. Rael possesses immense power, speed and combat skills, up to the point of being considered the strongest of his clan. However he has a major weakness: he tends to get emotional in combat, which results in him making mistakes. He is also overconfident of his abilities and continues to underestimate the enemy, even after losing to them. Like Rajak he can create multiple copies of himself with a maximum of 3-4, whereas his brother can create much more.  ~!He proposed to Seira 10 years ago, but was rejected. When he couldn’t contain his anger and destroyed everything around him, Rajak caught him and sentenced him to 10 years of confinement. According to Regis, it is suspected that Rael only wants to marry Seira to establish himself as a clan leader. After 10 years he comes back to the human world to fetch Seira and take her back to Lukedonia as ordered by the current Lord. !~

(Source: Wikipedia, Noblesse Fandom Wikia)

Woo Ik-Han (Kor. 우익한) is a regular human and best friends to Shinwoo, Yuna and Suyi, in addition to Regis, Seira and Rai. He spends most of his free time on his computer.  Ikhan is 157cm in height (about the same as Regis) and wears spectacles.  A running gag throughout the Manhwa is Ikhan's worry about his relatively short height. Initially, when Regis and Seira joined his class at school, Ikhan showed extreme intrest in the new students, which others supposed was Ikhan developing a crush on Seira. However, it is later revealed that Ikhan was rather enraptured by Regis, for Ikhan stated that he always wanted a fellow 'short' friend. Throughout his adventures, Ikhan is seen giving Regis foods and candies that are long and thin (such as Pocky) stating that he and Regis must eat them to grow taller (a pun on the stature of the food).  His hacking and computing skills are extremely proficient. He was able to match Tao's speeds when Tao tried to hack into Ikhan's uncle's police databases. He is also the best when it comes to computer games as it is mentioned by Shinwoo that Ikhan defeated him everytime. Ikhan also shows to be quite brainy rather than brawny, taking school very seriously compared to Shinwoo.  [noblesse.wikia]

Race: Noble

The previous Lord was a kind person and trusted the ones around him. He took a liking to humans and their traditions. He could at times be quite humorous calling Frankenstein a peacock, who returned him the favour by calling him a bugger. All in all, he seemed to have a quite easy going personality compared to his daughter, the current Lord. He displayed a fatherly nature towards her, nagging her for her unladylike behavior and warning her to be careful around guys since they can’t be trusted. He also cared for Rai and wished that he would become the next Lord instead of his daughter. He even gave Rai two silver crosses as a gift stating that it was a human tradition. One of them serves as Rai’s earring, the other one is located in Rai’s abandoned mansion in Lukedonia. His soul weapon is called Ragnarok. It takes the form of a beautiful decorated sword and it is supposed to be so powerful that humans associate it with the end of the world.  ~!The previous Lord went into eternal sleep 500 years ago, along with the other clan leaders, in order to free the next generation of their duty as Nobles and live their lives as they wish. He believed that it was time for the Nobles to change and leave it to the next generation. He truly cared for his daughter’s welfare and wished for her to escape her fate as the Lord, since the Lord’s life is burdened by huge responsibilities. Gejutel said to Rai that the previous Lord had wished to see him one last time before going into eternal sleep, but that he was nowhere to be found. He seemed quite keen on making Rai the next Lord, asking him several times to become the next leader of the Nobles but Rai would constantly decline. However, the previous Lord insisted because he wanted Rai to escape being the Noblesse, who faces an even harder fate than the Lord. In order to convince Rai, he even went as far as to hide a part of his soul weapon in a temple in Rai’s mansion.!~  (Source: Wikipedia, Noblesse Wikia)

__Age:__ unknown (>820)
__Race:__ Noble
__Occupation:__ Landegre clan leader
__Eye color:__ Red
__Hair color:__ Silver with two black lines

Gejutel is Regis’s grandfather and is seen with a walking stick and a monocle. He has the same sense of honour that Regis possesses and tests him on the issue of protecting humans. He seems to be on tense terms with Frankenstein. He is the head of the Landegre clan and he is the only one who served under the previous lord. The other clan leaders went to eternal sleep with the previous Lord or betrayed him. He was secretly given the task to guide the current Lord in order to lessen the confusion and chaos when the previous Lord and clan leaders went into eternal sleep. ~!Gejutel was sent out by the Lord to find out where Seira and Regis were staying and what they were doing. When he returns to report to the Lord, he tells Regis and Seira not to trust Frankenstein, but they can trust Rai. When reporting to the Lord, he conceals the truth to keep Rai and Frankenstein’s identity hidden. However, Rael lets out that he confronted unknown people with power, which leads to Gejutel being accused of treachery. !~

(Source: Wikipedia, Noblesse Fandom Wiki)

__Age:__ Unknown (>25)
__Race:__ Human (modified)
__Occupation:__ (deceased)
__Eye Color:__ White
__Hair Color:__ (bald)

M-24 is a large, bulky, and muscular guy with purplish-tinted skin, who wears a black fedora with a gray turtleneck sweater, black jacket, and dark pants. Though he appears to be cruel and cold-hearted at first, it is later revealed that he can be very compassionate and caring towards others. He shares a very close relationship with M-21 because they were the only 2 remaining from their group. Together, they try to find out their comrades’ names. He even wished for M-21 to call him ‘older brother’ because he thinks that previously in his life, he had younger siblings.  M-24 was one of the first 100 humans (M-1 to M-100) that were experimented on by the Union. He is considered a failed experiment, like M-21, and he is dependent on pills from the union that prevent his body from deteriorating.  In time he has developed the ability of minor mind-control as a side effect of the experiments done on him. He helped M-21 to learn how he could withstand mind control by launching several attempts of mind control on him. He was also capable of producing ‘infected’ and control them.   ~!He dies in chapter 78: He is killed by Jake while trying to buy some time for Shinwoo and his friends to escape.!~  ~!In Chapter 246, it is revealed that he was saved by Dr. Crombell and has not died. He is still an experiment, though, but has leveled up and stabilized.  He has escaped the lab and is on the run in the city where he eventually meets KSA agents and also Rai and others.  Several chapters later on M-21's request Frankenstein agrees to examine and treat M-24 personally and takes him to his own lab at home. M-24 keeps behaving strangely but because he remembers things only real M-24 would know, M-21 believes in him.   ~!However, in chapter 255 it was revealed by Yuri that this M-24 is in fact a fake - his real identity is Mark, a member of the same assassination team as Yuri. Mark has assumed M-24's identity to fulfill his infiltration mission (it's explained that he has absorbed a number of M-24's cells to gain some of his memories and abilities - along with his unstable body condition). There is no further explanation about the original M-24 at this point.!~

Race: Human Occupation: student Eye colour: brown Hair colour: brown Yuna is a beautiful young girl with a friendly, shy and quiet personality. Ik-Han and Shinwoo are childhood friends of her. She’s a student of Ye Ran High School and she’s in the same class as Shinwoo, Ik-Han and the others. Shinwoo had a crush on her since they were kids. She also becomes friends with Rai and visits him at Frankenstein’s home together with Shinwoo and Ik-Han. When she and Rai are introduced to video games, she appears to be quite competent despite it being her first try.   Sources: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noblesse_(manga) http://noblesse.wikia.com/wiki/Noblesse_Wiki

Age: Unknown Race: Modified Human Affiliation: Union Occupation: Assassination Unit First Appearance: Chapter 30  Mary is a modified human who serves the Union as a member of its Assassination Squad where she was partnered with Jake. She was the first female modified human shown within the series as well as one of the earliest antagonists.   Mary  is one of the first female experiments seen in the series. She is one of the highest ranked and most powerful of the successful experiments created by Dr. Crombel. The assassination unit of the Union is composed by her and Jake. It is implied that Mary is more powerful that her partner, which means that she holds a higher rank and commanding capability.   Mary, though quiet, is very intelligent and loyal to Dr. Crombel. She rarely displays emotion, which frequently annoys Jake, her partner. She has a very cold and cruel nature, and always strictly follows her missions. When she died, everyone in the Union, including the members of the DA-5, showed surprise. They all found it hard to believe that she could have been killed.   She has been shown to have the ability to transform her arms, and in this transformed state she gains immense speed and strength. It is implied that she is even more powerful than Jake, for he had vowed to kill her and Dr. Crombel one day, but not until he became stronger. Jake is also afraid of her, further attesting to Mary's immense strength.  Source:  [Noblesse Wiki](http://noblesse.wikia.com/wiki/Mary)
Na Yonsu is a modified human and a KSA agent. She’s married to An Sangeen who’s also her current work partner.

Race: Modified Human Affiliation: Union Occupation: DA-5 First Appearance: Chapter 107  Shark [is] a Modified Human who worked for the Union as a member of the DA-5, a special forces team of the Union that was created by Dr. Aris and led by Krantz.   Shark  is a member of DA-5. Created by Dr. Aris, he specializes in short distance, massive scale combat. He takes pleasure in killing. It is revealed later in the fight with DA-5 members against the protagonists that he killed all the people that Takeo made contact with in their prior missions and that his actions were sanctioned by Krantz. He is absorbed by Krantz and killed.   He is a brutal, cruel and heartless experiment. He loves to kill people for his own amusement and takes any opportunity to do so. He is extremely haughty in nature and is also easily provoked. His bloodthirsty nature has made him detestable to other members like Tao and Takeo.   Shark specializes in short distance combat. He uses sharp weapons like- small daggers and throwing knives to shred his enemies into pieces.  Source:  [ Noblesse Wiki ](http://noblesse.wikia.com/wiki/Shark)

Suyi is an attractive young girl and a pretty popular pop idol who is also studying at Ye Ran High School. She first appeared in chapter 94, when she returned to school after doing a concert while being escorted by Hansu. She’s a friend of Ik-Han, Shinwoo and Yuna and often hangs out with them. The kids tend to avoid visiting crowded places, because people would stare at Suyi. She often joins the others in visiting Frankenstein’s house. Even though Suyi is popular, she prefers leading a normal life.

Age: Unknown Race: Modified Human Affiliation: Union Occupation: Captain of Cerberus First Appearance: Chapter 231  Taze [is] a Modified Human who worked for the the Union as the captain of Cerberus, the personal guard and strongest military force of the 12th Union Elder. She is the personal bodyguard of the Elder and stays with him rather than with other Cerberus members.  Taze is very arrogant and ruthless when dealing with people other than the Elder, be it her allies or her enemies. She is overconfident about her own abilities and is quick to underestimate others.   Taze is way stronger than her fellow Cerberus agents. Her strength and speed are several times greater than those of her fellow members, marking her captaincy.   (Source: Noblesse Wikia)
He’s a modified human and a KSA agent. Sangeen is married to his work partner Na Yonsu.

Krantz [is] a modified human who worked for the Union as the Leader of the DA-5, a special forces team created by Dr. Aris.  Krantz is the leader of DA-5. He was created by Dr. Aris. He is usually shown on the sidelines and doen't fight with weak opponents.

~!He is first seen fighting against Regis an overpowers him. Later on he drains the power of Shark when it appears that he cannot defeat Rai alone. He then attempts to drain Tao's powers but Ikhan begs Rai to save Tao which Rai does. He is last shown being defeated by Rai.   Krantz has a cold and cruel personality and will do anything for the success of a mission. Krantz has been shown to stop the violent actions of Shark when Shark acts out of control. He was also allowing Shark to kill people Takeo met in the past without letting Takeo know. He hates dealing with lower ranking experiments.  He is very arrogant about his strength and claims that DA-5 was made just for him. Though it is revealed by Takeo later on that Krantz was very scared of Dr. Aris. Krantz is usually shown as calm but lost his cool and became angry when Regis managed to injure him.   Krantz is the strongest of DA-5 and was according to Tao, all of them together also can't defeat him. Krantz fights without using any weapons.!~

(Source: [Noblesse Wiki](http://noblesse.wikia.com/wiki/Krantz))

Race: Modified Human Affiliation: Union Occupation: DA-5 First Appearance: Chapter 107  Hammer [is] a modified human and a member of the special forces team within the Union known as DA-5.   Although he has violent tendencies at a level near Shark's (although never expressed facially), he is logical enough to avoid trouble and can use situations to his advantage, no matter how cowardly it may be. Even though he is arrogant of his strength, also accepts his defeat when facing a stronger opponent in order to survive. He does not hesitate to take hostages or harm even females. However, to his misfortune, when battling Seira , he believes that since she is a female, she will be an easy defeat. This [was an] understatement of Seira's powers.  As a member of DA-5, Hammer can be assumed as skilled fighter with or without his weapons. Hammer is a weapons specialist but can also indulge in combat if needed. He has been shown to use a wide variety of explosives when battling, which became a problem when arriving in South Korea for DA-5, because as Tao stated, the city is peaceful and full of civilians so he could not run free firing explosives as he usually likes to do during missions.  He also used a very heavy type of gun when battling Seira.﻿ Other of his equipment include a poison gases and sleeping gases. Like other members of DA-5, Hammer can also improve his skills by eating the drug, 'D'.

Jung Hansu Race: Human Occupation: idol Hair colour: black Hansu is an idol and an acquaintance of Suyi. He appears in chapter 94 of the manga while escorting her back to school after a concert. She doesn’t really like him, but Shinwoo and the others wanted to meet him so she brought him along to do them a favour.    ~!When M-21 notices Hansu’s car on the school grounds while the place is off-limits for vehicles, he asks him to move it. Hansu refuses, stating that he won’t take long anyway. When M-21 insists, he asks his bodyguard to take care of it. This leads to quite some commotion, but eventually they back off and leave the school.!~  source: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noblesse_(manga) http://noblesse.wikia.com/wiki/Noblesse_Wiki
Hansu's bodyguard

description:
When the warrior Hamel sacrifices himself to protect his rival Bermut Lionhart, he makes Bermut vow to vanquish the last of the demon kings. Reincarnated with his memories 300 years later, he is shocked to find that not only are the demon kings still alive, but that he has been reborn as Eugene Lionhart, a member of his former rival’s bloodline! Now, as Eugene comes of age, he must train to prove himself as a Lionhart and eliminate the remaining demon kings once and for all.

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: Eugene Lionheart is the titular protagonist of the web novel Damn Reincarnation. In his previous life, he was known as Hamel Dynas, and was one of the Five Great Heroes who vanquished three of the five Demon Kings of the Devildom of Helmuth long ago. After dying in the castle of the Demon King of Incarceration, he found himself reborn 300 years later as a distant relative of his comrade, Vermouth Lionheart. Reborn into a collateral branch family of the Lionheart Family, the son of Gerhard Lionheart, he swore to finish the task his comrades could not: Kill all the Demon Kings.

Sienna Merdein, also known as Wise Sienna, is a companion of Stupid Hamel and also the magician of the hero party that was dispatched to defeat Demon Kings. She is known as one of the greatest magicians in magic history.
Ciel Lionheart is the daughter of Gilead Lionheart and the twin sister of Cyan Lionheart. She is a member of the direct line of the Lionheart family.
Carmen Lionheart is a member of the Lionheart Family, part of the Council of Elders and captain of the third division of the Black Lions.
Balzac Ludbeth is the Tower Master of the Black Magic Tower.
Bermut Lionhart also known as Bermut the Great is a companion of Hamel and also the leader of the hero party that dispatched to defeat Demon Kings.
Anise Slywood was a companion of Stupid Hamel and also the healer and buffer of the hero party that dispatched to defeat Demon Kings. She was also the Saintess of the Holy Empire of Yuras.
Kristina Rogeris is a companion of Eugene Lionheart and also the sole saint candidate of the Holy Empire of Yuras.
Mer is Sienna Merdein's familiar and it's her duty to manage the floor of Akron on which Witchcraft is located. Her consciousness is located within Witchcraft.

**Age:** ~!300+!~

Molon Ruhr, also known as the 'Brave Molon', is a member of the Five Great Heroes, taking the role of the tank for the party. He is also the founder and former ruler of the Northern Ruhr Kingdom.

alternative: Spirit Princess of the White Tower of Magic

characters.description: Melkith El-Hayah, known as the White Tower Master, is the master of one of the Five Magic Towers in the Magic Kingdom of Aroth, namely the White Magic Tower. She has contracts with the Spirit Kings of Earth and Lightning.

alternative: Mad Dog of the Red Tower of Magic

characters.description: Lovellian Sophis is Master of the Red Magic Tower. He is also the master of Eugene Lionheart in the field of magic.
Genos Lionheart is the Black Lions’ Second Division Captain and a member of the Lionheart Family’s collateral branch, whose ancestor was Vermouth’s second son.

Gilead Lionheart is the Patriarch of the Lionheart Family as well as a member of the council. He is the husband of Tanis Lionheart with whom he fathered Eward. He also married Ancilla Lionheart, with whom he had a pair of twins, Cyan and Ciel.
Dominic Lionheart is the grandson of the Immortal White Lion Doynes Lionheart and the wielder of the Annihilation Hammer Jigollath. He is the leader of the First Division of the Black Lions.
Gion Lionheart is the younger brother of Gilead Lionheart as well as a member of the Black Lions.
Cyan Lionheart is one of Gilead Lionheart's son and a member of direct lineage of the Lionheart Family.
Doynes Lionheart is a member of the Lionheart Family and leader of the Black Lions. He is a powerhouse who wields the Demonic Spear Luentos.

title.english: The Lazy Lord Masters the Sword

synonyms: The Lazy Prince Becomes a Genius
Der faule Lord meistert die Schwertkunst
description:
After witnessing the shocking death of his mother, young Airen Farreira uses sleep to escape his painful reality, earning him the nickname, “the lazy lord”. Yet, in spite of others’ jeers and whispers, Airen has no intention of changing his ways. But when he awakens one day from a dream about a mysterious swordsman, his life’s trajectory takes a complete turn...

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: A boy who sleeps to run away from reality. People mocked him, calling him a deadbeat, but he had no wish to change. Until one day, he dreamt of a swordsman... It was a dream about a talentless man who had been training by swinging his sword for decades.

synonyms: 俺だけレベルアップな件〜ラグナロク〜
我独自升级 : 诸神黄昏
description:
In a world of gates, monsters, and hunters galore, Soo-Ho Sung is…well, he’s just an ordinary college student. Sure, his parents went missing right before the gates started appearing three years ago, and he occasionally had a weird dream where he could beat up monsters and level up like a video game, but other than that? There’s absolutely nothing special about him. So when a sudden monster outbreak occurs on his campus, he must fight back every instinct screaming at him to run away as he takes a page out of his dad’s book and rushes to save his classmate. The chances of making it alive are looking bleak, until—PING! [Congratulations on becoming a Player.]

(Source: Ize Press)

characters.description:
Sung Suho displays little interest in things that bore him and don't get his blood pumping, especially his education. He also likes to get physical against any bullies who are stupid enough to pick on him and has an intense desire to surpass his father, who always easily defeats him in their sparring matches.

~!Sung Suho is the son of [Jin-U Seong](https://anilist.co/character/129928/JinWoo-Sung) and [Hae-In Cha](https://anilist.co/character/138789/HaeIn-Cha).!~

alternative: The Weakest Hunter of All Mankind

characters.description:
__Class:__ Mage
__Relative(s):__ [Park Kyung-Hye](https://anilist.co/character/209396/KyungHye-Park) (Mother), [Sung Jin-Ah](https://anilist.co/character/138791/JinAh-Sung) (Sister), ~![Sung Il-Hwan](https://anilist.co/character/138790/IlHwan-Sung) (Father), [Cha Hae-In](https://anilist.co/character/138789/HaeIn-Cha) (Wife), [Sung Su-Ho](https://anilist.co/character/306654/Suho-Sung) (Son), [Yoo Jin-Ho](https://anilist.co/character/136076/JinHo-Yoo) (Brother in Law)!~
~!__Guild:__ Ahjin Guild (Guild Master)
__Affiliation:__ Korean Hunters Association (helper), White Tiger Guild (helper), Hunters Guild (helper), Knights Guild (helper), Ahjin Guild (Guild Master)!~

Seong Jin-U is the protagonist of [Solo Leveling](https://anilist.co/manga/105398/Solo-Leveling/) and is known as an infamously weak E-Rank Hunter. He is a humble and benevolent individual who cares deeply for his family and has an ardent desire to become stronger. As a result, he shares a close relationship with his sister and his mother, and rarely wastes an opportunity to refine his skills and gain more power.

~!He becomes an S-Rank hunter after being given a chance to become stronger by the System.!~

Born from the Ant Queen on Jeju Island, The Ant King becomes the main threat during the Fourth Jeju Island Raid.

~!Single-handedly responsible for the deaths of over 8 of the 16 S-Rank Hunters during the raid.!~

~!After being killed by Sung Jinwoo, the Ant King was revived as one of his shadow soldiers, and was given him the new name of Beru.!~
Esil Radiru, or Elisa Radiru, is a daughter of the Radiru chief and an Aristocratic Demon found at the S-Rank Demon's Castle Instant Dungeon.

__Class:__ Tanker
__Guild:__ ~!Ahjin Guild (Vice-Guild Master)!~

Yoo Jin-Ho is a D rank hunter and is [Jin-U Seong](https://anilist.co/character/129928/JinWoo-Sung)'s faithful assistant and combat partner.
He is a S rank hunter and master of the White Tiger guild.
An A rank hunter that works for Hunter's association of Korea.
Choi Jong-In is one of the 10 S-Rank Hunters of South Korea. He is also the Guild Master of the Hunters Guild.
Il-Hwan is a muscular middle-aged man with black eyes, shaggy black hair, and slight facial hair. When using his powers or agitated, his eyes glows bright yellow.
Thomas Andre (트마스 아드레) is one of only 5 National Level Hunters that exist and is considered to be the strongest Tank on Earth. He is also the Guild Master of the Scavenger Guild.
B-rank Hunter and An inspector working for South Korea's Hunter Association, Monitoring Division.
Laura is the secretary of Scavenger Guild, the strongest guild in the USA. She is a composed individual who rarely ever shows any emotion.
Son Ki-Hoon (손기훈) is the Team Leader of Attack Force B of the Hunters Guild.
Hwang Dong-su is an​ S-class hunter who works for Scavenger's Guild in America.
Ma Dong-Wook (마동욱) is one of the 10 S-Rank hunters of South Korea and the guild master of Fame Guild.
Famous Korean actor, known as Asia's biggest movie star. He is also an A-Rank Hunter.
Greed is a shadow owned by [Jin-Woo Sung](https://anilist.co/character/129928/JinWoo-Sung). ~!Greed is the shadow of [Dong-Su Hwang](https://anilist.co/character/136075/DongSu-Hwang).!~

Former Korean S-Rank Hunter. ~!About one year before the events of the main storyline, Eunseok participated in the 3rd Jeju Island Raid alongside Baek Yoonho and Min Byung-Gyu. Unfortunately, the raid went sideways and Eunseok was killed under unknown circumstances.!~
Hwang Dongsuk is a C-rank Hunter and the older brother of [Dong-Su Hwang](https://anilist.co/character/136075/DongSu-Hwang).
Jongsoo Park is a Korean A-Rank Hunter and the Guild Master of the Knights Guild.
Tae-Gyu Lim is a Korean S-Rank hunter who specializes in archery magic and the Guild Master of the Fiend Guild.

Korean A-rank hunter and the vice-guild master of the White Tiger Guild.

~!She's the daughter of S-rank hunter Baek Yun-Ho!~

synonyms: 1万年ぶりに帰還したプレイヤー
เพลเยอร์ผู้กลับมาในรอบหมื่นปี
description:
Oh Kangwoo the Demon King has had it with ruling over Hell and wants to return to Earth. But when he finally gets there, not only are his powers sealed, but the Earth he once knew has turned into an MMORPG free-for-all. Dimensional gates have appeared all over the world, and "players" enter them to make a living by hunting monsters. If Kangwoo wants to survive in this dangerous game, he's going to have to level up, and fast. But for this demon king, hell on earth might be worse than Hell itself!

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: __Height:__ 178 cm

title.english: The Max Level Hero Strikes Back!

synonyms: Max Level Hero is Making a Comeback!
The Max Level Hero has Returned!
最終レベル英雄のご帰還
Saishuu Level Eiyuu no go Kikan
การกลับมาของวีรบุรุษเวลตัน
description:
Struck by an enemy’s arrow, the powerless Prince Davey O’Rowane falls into a coma. His soul travels to a place where the greatest of the great gather—the honorable Hall of Heroes. There a thousand years pass as Davey undergoes excruciating training under their watchful eyes to become a hero too strong for his own good. Now back to his timeline and his kingdom, he’s wide awake and the enemies hiding in the king’s court better be prepared. The prince they had dismissed is now their biggest threat!

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: Void Demon

synonyms: ยอดนักดาบผู้โอบอุ้มดารา
description:
The so-called “Lighthouse of the North,” the prosperous trading town of Schoarra, hides a dark underbelly: seedy slums ruled by five ruthless crime bosses. When streetwise orphan Vlad finds the brothel he works for decimated by a disgraced knight, he turns to the path of the blade, pledging himself to the pursuit of power by sword. Blessed with the ability to seek wisdom from his sentient sword, Vlad embarks upon a journey of growth and peril as swordsman in service to the powerful House Vayezid.

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: An orphan living in Schoarra's slums. Despite his lowly birth, his appearance bears resemblance to nobility.
The second son of House Vayezid.
Vlad's childhood friend.
The heir to the Hynal family. She is calm and dignified despite her young age, though she shows a different side of herself to Vlad.
Josef's knight. He is one of the strongest knights in the north, and becomes Vlad's mentor when he comes under Josef's wing.
The madam at the Smiling Rose. She's very close with Vlad, since the day he was first brought to her by Jorge as an orphan.

An old blacksmith living in the slums of Schoarra. He gives Vlad his masterpiece, a sword that Vlad cherishes throughout his journey.

~!Vlad later visits the old blacksmith only to find him dead in his home. He places the sword in the blacksmith's hands and gives him a proper burial, etching the words "Best blacksmith in Schoarra" on his gravestone.!~
The eldest son of Count Vayezid and Josef's half-brother. He is known as one of the most powerful knights of the north.
Count Vayezid's second wife and Josef's mother.

One of the five bosses who rule over the slums of Schoarra. As a former knight, he is strong and kind, taking in an orphaned Vlad.

~!He is later killed by Godin, his former squire.!~
A clerk working for Captain Hoover. He's a close childhood friend of Vlad and Jemina.
A high-ranking warrior from the Budaate barbarian tribe.

A knight that serves Sigmund, the new count of Gaithar.

~!He kills his former teacher, the person who has saved Vlad, Jorge, setting Vlad on the path of vengeance.!~

A prostitute at the Smiling Rose. She's a close acquaintance of Vlad's, who helps her after she is abused by a customer.

~!She is later killed after being trafficked by Black Bear.!~
Sarnus Dragulia's heir, and the captain of the dragonslayers.
An old knight, and one of the most powerful of his era.
A knight acquainted with Zayar. He maintains a neutral stance amongst the Vayezids.
One of the five bosses who rule over the slums of Schoarra.
One of the five bosses who rule over the slums of Schoarra.
One of the five bosses who rule over the slums of Schoarra.
One of the five bosses who rule over the slums of Schoarra.
The Bishop of Schoarra.
A knight serving Josef. He has excellent tracking abilities.
A knight serving Josef.
The master of House Vayezid, and the father of Rutger and Josef.

synonyms: 三流反派的學院生存記
description:
Ed Rothstaylor is a third-rate villain in a game, disowned by his family and kicked out of the dormitory for his misdeeds. One day, our main character wakes up as this very Ed, and realizes he must earn a scholarship so he can graduate and be set for life. Now living in the woods, he resolves to keep away from the protagonists, but four of the female leads just won't leave him alone. Not only that, his presence starts to change the timeline and events of the game! Can Ed help the story progress while staying out of the limelight?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description:
He was originally the successor to the Rothstaylor family, a ducal family, but was excommunicated from the family after insulting the princess and lost his surname.

Due to his past life experience, he has a very serious and cautious personality. Compared to other characters, he acts cold, does not easily give affection to others, does not easily share his worries, and does not easily trust others.

She is lazy and only does things she wants to do. Supposedly she became lazy because she was too strong before even arriving to the academy.

The greatest genius at her job and a powerful mage who has reached the pinnacle of the strongest bloodline in the world. She was born with remarkable magical talent that caught the attention of the great magician Glockt from an early age.

The heroine of the game "Sylvania's Failed Sword Saint". The adopted daughter of the owner of the Elte Trading Company, also known as the Golden Daughter. She is one of the 6 main characters in the original story of the game.

In the original game, she was directly related to most of the bad endings, and was said to have been a nuisance character who angered many users, calling her the "bad ending maker".

She is the top student in her second year and is a spirit master who handles spirits.

A girl who seems to be the embodiment of kindness and innocence. She also wants to live up to the expectations of those around her.
She was a saint and the highest ranking figure in the Telos Church. She entered the academy disguised under the name Kylie Eckner.
She is the third princess of the Chloe Empire.

A first-year student in the combat club, he originally trained in martial arts, but his talent is below average. After entering Sylvania Academy, he realized that his talent lay in swordsmanship and belatedly began to stand out by taking up swords.
He is said to be a naturally righteous and kind boy, and he is a growth-type protagonist who experiences hardships and adversities that most people cannot even imagine for several years before growing up.
The chairman of Elte Trading Company. Lortel Kecheln's adoptive father. A prominent merchant with the splendid nickname of the Golden King. A sophisticated and luxurious gentleman.

title.english: The Reason Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion

synonyms: Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion
Cómo Raeliana acabó en la mansión del Duque
Raeliana – Warum sie die Verlobte des Dukes wurde
Comment j'ai survécu au Manoir Wynknight
彼女が公爵邸に行った理由
Kanojo ga Koushaku Yashiki ni itta Riyuu
Vị Hôn Thê Khế Ước Của Công Tước
พระเอกของฉันเป็นท่านดยุค
Okoliczności, które sprawiły, że Raeliana trafiła do posiadłości diuka
description:
Eunha Park was just a regular girl desperate to get into college, but when she finally does, her elation is cut short as she's pushed off a roof—only to wake up as Raeliana McMillan, a character from a novel whose death serves as the catalyst for the story's events. But Raeliana refuses to die a second time and is determined to change her fate, no matter what!

(Source: Yen Press)

alternative: レリアナ・マクミラン

characters.description: Reincarnated as only a side character dying in the hands of her fiancée, Raeliana Mcmillan is the badass main female character who is determined to live her life and not die as she was destined to do so. In a moment of desperation, she goes to Noah Wyknight and offers him a contract for an arrange marriage, to avoid her doom by canon fate.

alternative: ノアボルスティア・ウィンナイト

characters.description: The famous Duke of Wynknight and the main male protagonist of the story. In the original timeline, he ends up with Beatrice but due to Raeliana changing the original timeline to avoid her fate, he fell for Raeliana instead. He's Siatrich's younger brother.

A highly skilled young knight who serves Noah. He is very quiet and outwardly stoic, particularly with those he does not trust. He is very gullible and likes sweets.He is discriminated against for his Alasa heritage.

alternative: ジャスティン・シャマル

characters.description: Vivian's brother and a knight who serves the king.

alternative: シアトリヒ・ニューリアル・チェイモス

characters.description: Noah's older half-brother and the king of Chamos. One of his legs is completely paralyzed. He is a womanizer and has a meddlesome and talkative personality. While he seems careless, he is quite cunning.
A noblewoman who has feelings for Noah. She is arrogant looks down on those with lower social standing.

Beatrice Tranchett, the best friend of Raeliana Mcmillan since childhood. She is also the female lead of the novel in which Raeliana is in. According to the novel; Noah Wynknight falls for her after she successfully solves the mystery regarding her best friend; Raeliana's death.

alternative: ローズマリー・マクミラン
キース・ウエスタンバーグ
ナオミ・オブライアン
フリス・エリティール
ジェイク・ラングストン
ジョンデーン・マクミラン
ケイティ・マクミラン
フレンチ・ブルックス

characters.description: Raeliana's original fiancé who plots her murder.

synonyms: 小説の中のエキストラ
ผมก็แค่ตัวประกอบในนิยาย
成為我筆下小說的路人甲
description:
Wouldn’t it be a dream to wake up in a world of your own creation? For Kim Hajin, it’s nothing short of a nightmare. With no clue how or why he’s been transported into his web novel — as a mere extra, no less! — Hajin has little choice but to see his story through until the end. Lucky for him, as the author, he knows this perilous world like the back of his hand. But when discrepancies in the plot begin popping up left and right, Hajin soon realizes that things aren’t quite so simple, after all…

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: Yu Yeon-Ha has a gift for doing business and is one of Kim Hajin's trusted characters.

synonyms: นักสู้ทูปเบอร์
description:
Scrawny high school student Ho-Bin Yoo is probably the last guy you’d expect to star in a NewTube channel that revolves around fighting. But after following some advice from a mysterious NewTube channel, Ho-Bin is soon knocking out guys stronger than him and raking in more money than he could have ever dreamed of. Can Ho-Bin keep this up, or will he eventually meet his match?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: Ho-Bin is a boy from a poor family who gets bullied at school - until a lucky incident that leads him to become famous on NewTube.
Video editor of Ho-Bin Yoo. She is one year younger than Ho-Bin and Ji-Hyeok.
Cameraman and classmate of Hobin Yoo. He used to be Pakgo's cameraman before the fight during his gaming stream was released to the public.

Is one of the main antagonists.

~!He would also draw temporary but intricate black tattoos on his whole body and face.!~
Hobin Yoo's mother.
[Tae-Hun's](https://anilist.co/character/193930/TaeHoon-Seong) father
Ji-Un is a new and attractive newtuber who has a massive female following on NewTube because of his looks.

synonyms: เลเวลอัปไปกับเทพเจ้า
神と共にレベルアップ
Subi de Nível Com os Deuses
description:
“Maybe Inner Gods can never defeat Outer Gods…” so thought Yu-Won Kim, a plucky, high-ranking warrior, after a bitter defeat. But Yu-Won is too tenacious to give up. His loss becomes the dawn of a new journey as a returnee. With renewed determination, Yu-Won starts back from where he began, smashing monster after monster and relearning his skills before taking on the Tower once again. But can he fight his way through the tutorials and level up once more, or will his conquest crumble before him?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

characters.description:
Yuwon Kim is the protagonist and main character of Leveling with the Gods.
After losing the war against the Outer Gods, Chronos uses his power to send Yuwon back to the past to change the result of the war. After his regression, his only goal was to get stronger and gather his past allies to annihilate the Outer Gods.

description:
Following a momentous battle against giants for the fate of the world, Ronan emerges victorious as the last man standing of the imperial army. As he laments this hollow victory with his dying commander, Grand Marshal Adeshan, they quickly learn that the war is far from over and an overwhelming force of giants descends from the heavens. Fearing the worst, yet seeing hope in the courageous Ronan, Adeshan uses her last time slip to send him back to the past, so that he can enroll in the prestigious Phileon Academy and become the strongest swordsman the empire has ever seen!

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: [Ronan](https://anilist.co/character/311221)'s older sister. She wished for him to go the academy.
A shy person from [Ronan](https://anilist.co/character/311221)'s home village, who has a rare talent for magic.

synonyms: Match Made in Heaven by Chance
โชคชะตานำพารัก
description:
Jia Han, a 32-year-old freelancer with no work, is tired of her parents nagging her to get married and finally move out. When she runs into her childhood friend, Mincheol Jin, who is also feeling the same pressure from his parents, she blurts out that they should just get married to solve both of their problems. Little did she know he’d accept her suggestion, and she suddenly finds herself thrust into marriage. A story of an unexpected romance that’ll have you scrolling for more!

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: A 32 year old freelancer who still doesn’t have a full-time job.
A programmer and childhood friend of [Ji-A Han](https://anilist.co/character/266483).
Min-Cheol and Sang-U's manager.
Sang-U's second-oldest sister. Popular romance novelist and an influencer.
A friend and coworker of Min-Cheol.

Staff member of Café 2nd along with [Si-U](https://anilist.co/character/300190/SiU-Lee). Flirted incessantly with [Min-Cheol](https://anilist.co/character/266484/MinCheol-Jin) before discovering he was married to [Ji-A](https://anilist.co/character/266483/JiA-Han), but later apologizes and becomes a proper acquaintance and coworker of Ji-A's afterwards.
Jia's younger sister.
Staff member of Café 2nd, alongside [Na-Ri](https://anilist.co/character/300191/NaRi-Ju). The more capable worker of the two.
Jia's former editor while she was still a writer.
Sang-U's eldest sister. She's very elegant, put together and mature, but also tends to gets a kick out of teasing her brother.
CEO of Yeomi Entertainment. Occasionally visits Café 2nd.
A rookie reporter and a big fan of Ji-A's during her days as a popular author. She's keen on seeing Ji-A return to writing.

title.english: The Return of the 8th Class Mage

synonyms: Le Retour du magicien de classe 8
การกลับมาของจอมเวทระดับ 8
description:
As a powerful 8th class mage, Ian Paige took countless innocent lives under the orders of Emperor Ragnar, a close friend and ruler of the Greenriver Empire. Yet despite their closeness, Ragnar views Ian as a threat and subsequently poisons him. Using time magic, Ian saves himself and returns 30 years to the past. Now a young boy, Ian joins an elite order of mages to hone his abilities once again. This time, he’ll get revenge on the emperor who betrayed him and reclaim glory as an 8th class mage!

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: A powerful mage in his past and current life, Ian has a mature mindset befitting his true age in the forties-fifties, as well as an inner ruthlessness concealed by his courteous behavior.
The 3rd Princess of the Empire.
Mother of Ian Paige.
The Crown Prince of the Greenriver Empire and a playful idiot.
In Ian's previous life he was a royal alchemist--the greatest in the empire's history.

An Emperor and Ian's friend.

~!He attempted to murder Ian in fear of losing his kingdom to him. In the beginning of the story, he tried to poison Ian with the Flower of Rondor and burned the house down to make sure that Ian died.!~

synonyms: その悪女に気をつけてください
ระวังไว้ ยัยตัวร้ายกำลังมา
description:
Sit back and take in this romantic tale of an angelic heroine and her devoted suitors as they vie for the depths of her love... or not. This story’s about to go through some edits! After an accident, a modern-day college student awakens as the story’s villainess, Melissa Foddebrat. She’s far from anyone’s favorite, but she IS the daughter of the duke. Determined to live it up, this new Melissa is doing things her way — antiquated society, be damned! All idiots, prepare to step aside or perish!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 52 extra chapters.

characters.description:
After dying in a car accident, Han Da Young finds herself in the body of the villainess from a popular novel called "All the Men that Loved Her". She is determined to live as a jobless rich girl and making sure that the heroine of the novel does not get taken advantage of by the useless male leads.

Melissa has a very unique personality. Rather than repent for the deeds of her body's previous owner or fulfill the role of a villainess, Melissa initially sets out to live out the rest of her days as a pampered daughter of a duke—this is due to the constant studying and work she had to endure during her previous life.

Of course, Melissa does not get to enjoy her luxurious and relaxing fantasy for long, as she realizes the unsettling circumstances of the novel's original four love interests. Melissa makes it her job to protect the female lead from the influence of these characters, showing her resilience and unwavering disposition to do what she feels is right. She has no tolerance of the male leads' antics and is willing to beat them up if the situation befits it.

Melissa has no reluctance to do whatever she feels like doing. This also applies to her inclination and appreciation of her people, as shown in her continuing willingness to raise Yona Whitefall's pay and strong resolution to find a way to restore Nine Forton's fangs and tongue.

Melissa is also very independent. Throughout the series, she has conveyed her indifference to what others think of her, and refuses to conform to the nobility's ideals, as shown during the Spring Ball and the Hunting Competition. She learned swordsmanship although others objected toward it, and learned her talent in it.
Nine is Melissa's shy butler and a werewolf. He was rescued from the streets by Melissa, making him really loyal to her.

Yuri Elizabeth is the protagonist of the novel “The Brats I Love”. She was adopted into the Elizabeth family because of her magical ability. ~!She is forced to live through the novel's plot again and again.!~
Yona is a maid motivated by money. She is from a fallen noble house.
Jake is a sniper with stalkerish tendencies. He is the younger brother of the main protagonist, Melissa Podebrat.

Jack Forton is the strongest member of the werewolf clan (after Mizen Forton, the clan leader). He is second-in-command of the Forton household. He hates humans. The scar on his face is one that was left by Nine.
Cartena is Melissa's sword instructor, and a former knight for the imperial family. She initially mistook Melissa's intentions to learn swordsmanship for wanting to join the knights.
Ian is considered a very handsome man, and because of his good looks, he has fooled around with a lot of women. He is a selfish, shallow person, who used to be very cruel to Melissa, his fiancée,
He is a billionaire who pines after Yuri.
He is the father of Melissa Podebrat and Jake Podebrat

synonyms: The Return of the Crazy Demon
อสูรคลั่งผู้หวนคืน
description:
The Mad Demon, Ja-Ha Lee, dreams of becoming the God of Martial Arts. Unfortunately, his dreams are dashed after he falls off a cliff while running from the Demonic Cult for stealing the Jade of Heaven. Yet this is not the end for Ja-Ha -- he awakens from the fall to find himself back in his 20s. With his knowledge of the future and of martial arts, he now has a chance at revenge and at getting life right this time. Will he be able to fulfill his dream this time around, or is he doomed to face the same fate yet again?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: Ja-Ha dreamt of becoming a Martial God but fell off a cliff while running from the Demonic Cult after stealing and swallowing the Jade of Heaven. He then awakens and finds himself back in his 20s. He becomes a powerful and extremely deadly master martial artist infamous for his unpredictable and benevolent mindset, ruthlessness, and utter insanity.

synonyms: การกลับมาของเพลเยอร์แช่แข็ง
description:
When Seo Jun-Ho and his companions sacrificed themselves to defeat the frost queen, they thought they were restoring peace to Earth. But after 25 years of being frozen solid, Jun-Hho thaws out only to find that nine more floors appeared in his absence, only one of which has been cleared! As the only one who holds the key to clearing the next floor and defrosting his friends, Jun-Ho must step up once again. But has this hero been in hibernation too long to take on the world’s fearsome new foes?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

characters.description: Famously known as "Specter", he is one of the Five Heroes and also cleared the 1st Floor. He fought against the Frozen Queen and successfully killed her, but was then frozen for 25 years in order to absorb the nucleus.
Secretary and manager of Seo Jung-Ho. She's working under Association.
Member of the Dokkaebi guild.
CEO of Myungho Group which is the number one Korea company.
Virtuous Moon guild master.

synonyms: Unholy Blood – Die Rache der Vampirin
description:
All pure-blooded vampire Ha-Yan Park wanted to do was live a normal life. But the rise of half-bloods ten years ago transformed the world into a dangerous and frightening place—robbing her of her one true wish. Determined to return Korea to how it used to be, Ha-Yan teams up with local police captain Eun-Tae Hwang to wipe out the bloodthirsty killers in a tale of hot-blooded romance and revenge.

(Source: Yen Press, edited)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

characters.description:
**Height:** 160 cm (5'3")

A girl who conceals her identity as one of the strongest pureblood vampires in order to live normally as a college student. However, she cannot ignore injustice caused by others of her kind. She is infamously known as the 'White-Haired Vampire' by other vampires.

A handsome, talented and extremely perceptive police detective who is nicknamed the vampire-hunting 'Ghost' due to his excellent record of arresting vampires. He is currently investigating about a certain pureblood vampire.

Childhood friend of [Hayan](https://anilist.co/character/161331/HaYan-Park).

~!Later it is revealed that Yohan is actually "God", the leader of the Angels of Death and all other mixed-blood vampires.!~

~!Yohan was saved by Hayan's parents by being turned into a mixed-blood vampire before he succumbed to grievous injuries resulting from bullying. However, his desire for power led him to kill both of Hayan's parents and eating her father's heart, turning him into a half-pureblood vampire. He attempted to take Hayan's heart to become a true pureblood but stopped himself out of sentimentality for their friendship, although he shows a seemingly renewed interest in taking her heart as an adult.!~
Daniel is Vael's pet lion, whom Vael knew since he was a cub. Vael is very close to Daniel and is able to understand what he says.

synonyms: 神話級の帰属アイテムを手に入れた
พลิกชะตาคว้าไอเทมระดับเทพ
description:
In a world where technology and magic are almost indistinguishable from one another, monsters and creatures of myth and legend reign terror upon mankind. In humanity’s darkest moment, individuals with special god-like powers emerge to save the day. They are — the Awakened. Meet Jae-Hyun, a feeble Awakened human Raider, who struggles to make ends meet until one day a series of confounding events allow him to claim a powerful item that will change the course of history forever…

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

characters.description: The guild master of the Yeonhwa Guild. She is a top level healer known worldwide.
She was a famous top ranking magician before [Jae-Hyeon](https://anilist.co/character/305628)'s regression.
The daughter of Loki and the god of death who rules over Helheim, the world of the dead among the nine worlds of Norse mythology.
[Jae-Hyeon](https://anilist.co/character/305628)'s childhood friend.

Jae-Hyeon's senior at Milles Academy. He grew up as the youngest son of an S-class raider family, but unlike his other brothers, he had no talent for combat. Instead, he made a name for himself as the greatest alchemist.

title.english: The Skeleton Soldier Failed to Defend the Dungeon

synonyms: Skeleton Soldier Couldn't Protect the Dungeon
骸骨兵士はダンジョンを守れなかった
从1级开始的异世界骑士
พลทหารโครงกระดูกผู้มิอาจปกป้องดันเจี้ยน
description:
Meet the Skeleton Soldier, a meager but fiercely loyal fighter who serves to protect its master, Lady Succubus. Its dream of a peaceful life with her is shattered when they're both brutally murdered by a group of warriors one day. But what would’ve been a pathetic end to an unremarkable soul sparks a new beginning: when the Skeleton Soldier opens its eyes again, it has traveled back 20 years in time! “I must warn Lady Succubus of all the things to come!” But with no special combat skills and a history of failure and defeat, how can it stop the horrible events from unfolding again? Follow the Skeleton Soldier as it faces the most challenging quest of all—rewriting the ending to its own story.

(Source: TappyToon)

characters.description:
He is a skeleton who has the ability to return to a specific point in time every time he dies.

Skeleton was just a regular Skeleton Soldier minion placed under the Demon Lord Baal.
His past as a human remains unknown. His grave where his remains are buried had no clues about his past. The tombstone of his grave had been scratched so bad that they can't even see his name on it.

He is the mage who's been tormenting the Chandler Household for the past 300 years. He has been brainwashing the heir of the household by giving them an option of Obeying him for his protection.

When the direct heir of the Chandler Household reaches the age of 25. He heads past the barrier in the basement, not on his own volition to the Mage who's been in slumber for centuries. Then he links his body to the Mage's coffin, offering his life force until the day he dies.

He is the Lord of the Golden Dawn and high priest of Malphas in charge of the kings tabernacle.

She grew up in a Orphanage where she was raised by Headmaster Slime. Having been raised by a Non Human specie she showed no untrustworthy towards Skelly.

She despises humans because of what happened to her in the past. She was living a hard life having to kill another person at the young age of 10 years in order for her and her younger sister Haley to live.
She is the the necromancer who summoned Skeleton Soldier.
~!An exceptionally skilled necromancer who took a liking towards Skeleton Soldier (and also his master for a short period of time).!~
One of the 16 Demon Lords. His form is of a bipedal-lion riding a Bear
One of the 16 Demon Lords. He has the form of a Crow adorned with Jewels all over his body.

title.english: The Advanced Player of the Tutorial Tower

synonyms: The Tutorial Tower of the Advanced Player
El jugador avanzado de la torre del tutorial
チュートリアル塔の廃人
ผู้เล่นขั้นเทพแห่งหอคอยฝึกสอน
description:
After being trapped for 12 years in a tower full of regenerating monsters, Hyeon-U Kim is more powerful than just about any human or monster on Earth. Now that he’s free, he’s determined to find out who was behind his imprisonment, even if that means he has to kill hordes of monsters — and inadvertently save the world — along the way.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

characters.description: Hyeon-U Kim is more powerful than just about any human or monster on Earth. Now that he’s free, he’s determined to find out who was behind his imprisonment, even if that means he has to kill hordes of monsters.
AV is the guide of Hyeon-U Kim, sometimes Hyeon-U Kim feels like she's his daughter.
She is the second disciple of Hyeon-U Kim
Seo-Yeon Lee  is a first-generation hunter and the guild master of the Arang guild. She, along with Si-Hyeon Kim and Seok-Gwan Han, cleared the tower together along with Hyeon-U Kim.
She is the second climber that Hyeon-U Kim met.

Cheonma is a climber.

~!He was the master of Hyeon-U Kim for a short period of time and taught him the "Thunder God" martial art techniques.!~
Kang-Hyeon Lee is an 18th-generation Korean hunter. He was deemed a very powerful candidate behind Hyeon-U Kim.

Si-Hyeon Kim is the deuteragonist of the series. He is a high-ranking Korean hunter and the guild master of the Seoul guild. He was with Hyeon-U Kim back in 2006, as they were both first-generation hunters that cleared the tower. However, he was significantly younger at that time.

Hyeon-U remained his best friend and currently lives at his place, since he no longer has a home.
Seok-Gwan Han is a hunter that cleared the tower with Seo-Yeon Lee and Hyeon-U Kim. He is currently the guild master of the Goguryeo Guild.

Balrog is the boss of the Tutorial Towers who resides on the 100th floor. He's the final monster that acts as a gatekeeper to the portal. Those who defeat him can exit the tower and become hunters. However, 70 out of 95 hunters are killed by Balrog, making him the hardest monster in the tower. Balrog will always respawn when a new group of trainees appear.

title.english: 66,666 Years: Advent of the Dark Mage

synonyms: The Dark Magician Transmigrates After 66666 Years
จอมเวทเกิดใหม่ในรอบ 66666 ปี
description:
Diablo Volpir, a powerful dark mage, was defeated and sealed away in a battle against the 12 gods. He finally wakes up from his sleep 66,666 years later, however, in the body of a newborn baby, Jamie Welton! 9 years later, with a fraction of power he once held and with the loving family and peaceful environment he is now surrounded by, Jamie plans to exact revenge against the 12 gods that had sealed him away.

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: Jamie's mother.
Jamie's father
Jamie's little sister.

synonyms: 死に戻り騎士は今日も生きる
อัศวินวันเดียว
description:
Is dying repeatedly a blessing? Enkrid's life-long dream of becoming a knight looked to be forever out of reach, until one day he died... and woke up at the beginning of that same day! Now that he has unlimited chances to train and engage in mortal combat, just how far can he go?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: Enkrid is the protagonist of The Knight Only Lives Today. He possesses a curse which turns him back in time every time he dies to a “wall”.
Finn is the Platoon Leader of the Reconnaissance Team.
Leona is the successor of the Rochfried Merchants Guild and adopted daughter of Leonos Rochfried
Graham is the First Company, Tortoise Heavy Infantry Commander
The one Enkird sees in death

description:
Han-Soo Kang was an average boy living in the normal world when he was suddenly summoned to Fantasia, a fantasy world run by demons. Deemed the Chosen Hero, he’s spent the last ten years building himself up to defeat the lord of Fantasia - which turned out to be a piece of cake. As he eagerly awaits his return to the real world, the “god” of Fantasia appears and throws a wrench in his plan: a report card that reveals there’s more to being a hero than just might.

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

characters.description: Lanuvel is an archeologist and sorcerer that chases after ancient legends in the world of Fantasia. She's the guide of the heroes in the script of Fantasia Education Center ~!and a secret associate of the director of the school.!~

Mollang is a raninbow slime, a special type of slime that inhabitates in a village near the frontier of the Holy Empire. Kang Han-Su considers him his physical master and commands absolute respect from him.
Aqua is the daughter of the Fallen Hero and the Mermaid Queen of the Sad Song Lake's legends. She's also a common member of the Heroes Party.

Trainee Teacher is the second overseer send by the Teaching Staff to guiate Kang Han Soo. Although part of the Teaching Staff (trainee), she became a friend and ally of the protagonist. Their time spent together her want to become a teacher and awakened her desire to change for the better the Fantasia School's ways.

Ssosia is the daughter of the Demon King Pedonar and the creator of the system that controls Fantasia. She allied with the First Angel in order to stop her father but was later betrayed and became a prisoner in her world.
Aries is a royal knight of Elfheim Kingdom and the most loyal servant of the elf prince Nasus. She's considered the third strongest warrior of the elven race.
Hippolia is the lover and servant of Kang Han Soo, and one of the few persons he consider a true ally. Before meeting her master she was the mascot/administrator of the Hero's Festival.

Talia Alborea, also know as Elf K, is the daughter of Elf King Elfheim and his first queen and former crown princess of Elfheim Kingdom. She was also an ally of a Rebel Hero who tried to oppose the God of Fantasia.

Archer E is one of Elfheim's FIve Knights, the Elf Queen bodyguard and the master of princess Sylvia. She was missing in action after the kidnap of the elven queen and ended up captured and sell as a slave.

Pedonar, also known as Demon King Pedonar, is the ruler of the Demon Race and the strongest entity in the World of Fantasia, working as the destiny enemy of the hero, who must slay him to save the world. In reality the Demon King is the God of Space (Dark Matter) who was prisoned in the world he once protected by the Teaching Staff and its Director.
Devilish Queen is the tentative name given to the queen of the Dumpling Kingdom. She was a demon whorshipper and the high priestess of a dark cult rooted in her kingdom.

Elfheim Khan Lanuberg, also know as Boss K, was a comrade of the First Hero and nowadays an ally of Kang Han Soo. He was the third king of the elven race and founder of the Elfheim Kingdom until the God of Fantasia imprisoned him along his daughter, Talia, for trying to oppose him.
Fronesis is the matriach of the spirit race and one of the ancientest beings on the world of Fantasia. She's also the oldest god of Fantasia and the original guardian of the world.

Alex is the one of the strongest swordmen of Fantaisa the leader of the Imperial Knight of the Dumpling Kingdom. He's also one of the potential members of the Hero's party and the sword teacher of the heroes.
The Elf Queen is the missing queen of Elfheim Kingdom. ~!She is also the lover of the Demon King Pedonar.!~
The Elf King is the monarch of the elven country of Elfheim in the world of Fantasia.
The Dumpling King is the ruler of the Dumpling Kingdom and the one who ordered Lanuvel to summon Kang Han Soo in order to save his kingdom from the menace of the Demon King.

synonyms: I'll Be the Matriarch in This Life
In This Life, I Will Be the Lord
На сей раз я - хозяйка этой жизни
今世は当主になります
เกิดใหม่ชาตินี้ฉันจะเป็นเจ้าตระกูล
description:
The great Lombardi family was once at the top of the empire. After the death of its patriarch, the fate of the family and that of Firentia, born from a Lombardi and a peasant, fall to ruin at the hands of her useless and cruel cousins. But when she’s reincarnated as her seven-year-old self, she’ll work to protect the family’s honor, gain her grandpa Lulac’s favor, and prevent her own father’s death. In this lifetime, there’s only one way for her to win: become the head of their mighty household.

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: Perez is an illegitimate son of the emperor, born from a concubine, which puts him in a precarious position within the imperial family. Due to his status, he initially lives a harsh and secluded life, facing neglect and contempt from those around him. However, as the story progresses, Perez becomes a significant figure in the plot, particularly in his relationship with the protagonist, Firentia Lombardi.

Gallahan Lombardy is the biological father of Florentia Lombardy and the supporting character in I shall master this family.

He is very calm, patient and very energetic. Gallahan is shown as clingy and being lovely to his one and only daughter. Also, he really loves and cares for her. Since she lost her mother without getting to know her, he tries to be a mother figure as well.

Gallahan was madly in love with his lover Shan but she died soonly after their daughter was born. His nickname is Gally, but it was only used by Shan.

alternative: シャンナネット ロンバルディ

characters.description: She is the sister of Gallahan and the mother of the twins Giliou and Mayron.

alternative: クレリバン ペレット

characters.description: Twin Brother of Mayron Schulz.

alternative: メーロン スクルス

characters.description: Twin brother of Giliou Schulz
A skillful doctor in training.
Mother of Astana.

alternative: アルフェオ ジーン

characters.description: A talented artist/sculptor.

alternative: アスタナ ネレムプ ドゥレリ

characters.description: A prince who believes he's above all else which is the way his mother raised him

alternative: ビエス ロンバルディ

characters.description: Father of Bellezac

alternative: クロイトン アンジェナス

characters.description: A representative of the Dyurak Guild.

alternative: ベレサク ロンバルディ

synonyms: คู่มือการใช้งานของนักข้ามเวลา
description:
[Will you join the game?] Giyoung's suddenly thrown into a game of life and death. Not only that but he's also the player with the lowest stats. Still, he's got one skill on his side: the ability to read other players' status! He finds the opportunity of his life when he discovers that Hyunsung is a returner to this world. Now all Giyoung has to do is stick next to Hyunsung and game his way out of this tutorial.

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: __Species__: Human
__Species__: Human
__Species__: Human

description:
When an interdimensional portal appeared and released countless monsters across the world, humanity didn’t take the threat lying down. Mankind fought back, defeating the monsters' Demon King and creating a new way of life as "hunters." But when Taekyung Jin, a struggling, low-ranked hunter, accidentally logs into a game on a beat-up VR console, he finds himself trapped in an all-new world, unable to log out.

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: Jin Tae-Kyung is a low-rank hunter who picks up a VR machine and accidentally logs into the game, which is set in the world of Martial Arts. After many ups and downs, Tae-Kyung is able to escape this world.

synonyms: สมรภูมิไม่สิ้นสุด
description:
Da-Woon's ordinary life is turned upside down when he is summoned into the Dungeon, where he must play a deadly game, outlasting dangerous monsters and life-threatening traps. To make matters worse, he's only a mere crafter with zero combat abilities. But after Da-Woon falls into a trap and survives after a glitched reset, he's gained random but oddly helpful skills. He'll need to get creative to clear the game and return home, with a bloodthirsty assistant and an adorable ground squirrel along for the ride. Now that the rules no longer apply to him, what possibilities await in the tunnels below?

(Source: Tappytoon)

synonyms: วีน เหวี่ยง WILD มัธยมสาวพันธุ์ดุ
description:
Wild's High has a 42 year history as an all-girls private high school, meant solely for the elite. The girls of this school are trained daily in some of the deadliest forms of fighting around, from boxing, to sword-fighting, to taekwondo! This specialty school is the place where the most popular sporting event in the country is held, The Wild's League - the only place in the world where teenage girls partake in brutal fights... often to the death.

This year, Wild's has changed to a mixed-gender school. Despite opening their doors to males, the only one to apply is Song Jae-Gu. He has been granted a full 3-year scholarship regardless of grades, which he snaps up without second thought. For the past two years, every moment of his life has been spent taking care of his younger twin siblings.

But after meeting Queen, the bloody champion of Wild's League, drenching her in coffee and calling her a 'monster'... things are about to get messy - especially when he gets tied up with all the other unusual girls at this school!

Follow Jae-Gu's struggle, from being the only male in school full of beautiful and deadly women to learning to fight and stand up for himself!

characters.description: Choi Dal-Dal is a cute and bubbly young woman. She is the president of the Taekwondo club in Wild's High and has a friendly rivalry with Lee Mun-Yeong over martial arts and the attention of the series' protagonist, Song Jae-Gu.

Known primarily as Queen, In-Gwi is the heroine in the series, an S-Class ranked second-year student and the current Wild's League champion. She is a mixed martial artist, proficient in nearly every form of martial arts, where she helps spar with each of the school clubs. Her initial encounter with Jae-Gu leads to misunderstanding, due to a bad experience with a boy in her childhood. She nevertheless quickly develops feelings for Jae-Gu, who does not fawn over her like everyone else.

Lee Mun-Yeong is an S-class Wild's High School second year student, where she is the president of the boxing club and Queen's best friend and confidante. She is loud, rambunctious, and outgoing, as opposed to the reserved personality that Queen shows. However, when she is fighting seriously, she becomes a very powerful and frightening opponent, well-deserving of being Queen's best friend. She has a friendly rivalry with Choi Dal-Dal over martial arts and the attention of the series' protagonist, Song Jae-Gu.

__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10)

Song Jae-Gu is the main protagonist of the series. He is a first year at Wild's High and also the first male student to be enrolled into the former girls-only school after its conversion to a co-ed institution. He is currently not ranked. While he uses no materials, he's being taught boxing.

__Height:__ 162 cm

Lee Go-Seul is a first year student at Wild's high, like Song Jae-Gu. She is a member of the Wushu club and, while at first glance she appears weak and clumsy, her personality changes once she steps into a ring or is challenged. While clearly preferring armed combat (she walks around with a veritable arsenal in her bag) she is also adept at unarmed combat as well, giving her the appearance of a being a strong contender against even Queen.

She is shown to be taller than the average woman with a slender body. With straight blonde hair with a side parting to her bangs, her sharp features are framed gorgeously. She has piercing eyes and lips that are more often than not, set in a straight line or a frown. She's typically seen with a cold expression.
Lee Mi-Nam is a first year student at Gura High where he is training for Wild's League. He's a member of the boxing club.

Kim Hye-Sin is a student at Gura High and is an aggressive young woman. She was the former two-year kickboxing champion until Queen defeated her. She is a Gura School second year student, where she is training for a rematch against Queen in the future.

Kim Yeo-Jeong first appears alongside her fighting companion, Kim Jun-Gu, as guest fighters in the Wild's High League. Her opponent in the guest match is Choi Dal-Dal, whom she loses to. After her defeat, she is allowed to enter Wild's High and attend classes.

Kim Han-Gyeol is one of Jae-Gu's former schoolmates. He often bullied Jae-Gu in his past school and when he noticed that Jae-Gu was attending Wild's High began to torment him again. He is a freshmen at Gura High and specializes in kickboxing.

Charles Wilds is the Board President of Wild's High and the man who recruited Song Jae-Gu into the school with the promise of a three year scholarship as long as he attended. He made the decision to change the school from an all girls school to be a co-ed one.

description:
ATime has passed since the great confrontation at the Core Business tower. After Chun-woo Han destroyed Si-woon's ki-center, depriving him of his ability to practice martial arts, Si-woon thinks his time with the Murim is done. But his status as the sole disciple of the Nine-Doors Dragon makes him a target for many clans eager for revenge! How will he cope now that he's deprived of his ki? Meanwhile, graffiti in praise of the Nine-Doors Dragon begins appearing all around the world for all to see, and the Murim Alliance must react quickly. The Soldiers Under Command are on the move; will it be possible to stop them before the destruction of the world as we know it?

(Source: ABLAZE)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.
