Due the traits of a zombie, sucking life force out of beings near him, he is forced to move out of the human world, joining Serin in the world of "Chaos". Vowing one day to return to the human world to the side of his little brother, Jae Jyuk has to earn the right to possess the "Goblin Fire", which can open the door to the human world. For one to obtain the rights, one must've attained a rightful amount of power. Now, Jae Hyuk is looking for ways to obtain power, so he can one day meet his little brother again in the human world. ~!Jae Hyuk finds out that he is a "Negative", meaning his kind of power works differently from those with "Postive" magic power. He gains the mana stone known as "Depore" in a tower and is forced to fight and learn about negative magic. In order to control Depore he must have a strong desire, which is in this case, being with Serin.!~ ~!- Cavalier of the Abyss - (Immortal Regis Part 2) After a long series of events concerning Caladbolg, Jae Hyuk, now known as Regis Nex, eliminates anyone who seems to be siding with the Night clan, or the supporters of Caladbolg. He has taken an interest in Xix, who appears to be another undead, and wishes to know who his contractor, or master is, who has turned him undead.!~
Latique's partner and high skilled summoner.
Frivolous "Everchanging Blade".

A young magician who lives within Chaos. She is quite playful but much like the other magicians that reside there she seeks great power and that has led her to trying to use Jae Hyuk to gain even more, though she is unsuccessful.
One of Jae Hyuk's friends, they met due to his want for more power in order to become Infinity's diciple, though almost killing Jae Hyuk in the process.
A teacher from Regis who is not very fond of accepting students. She masks her intentions from all.

Head of the Vision clan.He can see the future. ~! 400 years ago, he was the great destroyer Noche, who grew attached to Karladbolg than any other king. He led Chaos almost to destruction and the effects were devastating. Because he was undead human, Karladbolg chose him to be his shell. Noche also had a contract with Depore. !~
The Mahou clan's successor.
The successor of the Vision clan, she is one of the people who tries to gain more powerful stones and gets extremely desperate while doing so.
A studant of Regis who is after Jae Hyuk because he want the king's stone. Very strong and bossy.
A mysterious guy that Jae Hyuk and Owen met at the tower. He and Depore knows each other.
One of the first people Jae Hyuk meets in Urvis (Ch 6). He is of the mahou clan (check?).
The magic stone of the demon clan.

Jae Hyuk's little brother who is very ill and the reason his brother tries to return to Earth from Chaos. ~! It is revealed that he was brought to Chaos by Serin to make up to Jae Hyuk for all that had gone wrong; unintentionally this lead to him turning into the Caladbolg!~

Serin's father and head of the demon clan. ~! Navarus is the one who brought Just to Regis and is claiming Just to be Regi's son. Navarus reason for doing this action is likely to rescue Serin from her imprisonment. !~

description:
What if the world was divided into people with martial arts powers and people without? Tae-Yeon Kang was one of the lucky few born with such powers. He enrolls in Murim Police University, a special school for those with powers to stand on the side of justice… but he has a secret of his own. He’s here to uncover the truth behind his father’s disappearance as well as seek protection from the Evil Murim Faction which is after his family’s secret book of martial arts techniques. At the same time, the legendary Ghost King makes his grand return, years after his mysterious disappearance. Just who is this masked anti-hero?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

synonyms: My Lucky Encounter From the Game Turned Into Reality
description:
In a world where magic co-exists with the rule of nobles, Adrian Lawrence seemed to have gotten lucky in life as the second son of a viscount. Despite this, Adrian is an outcast in a home controlled by his scheming stepmother and half-brother, who are set on ousting him. Little do they know that Adrian plays the game Chronicle Online, where he possesses great powers that can also be used in reality! With heirship to the viscounty up for grabs, can Adrian use his powers to level up his real life?

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: 看見彩虹的天才魔法師
โลกหลากสีของจอมเวทอัจฉริยะ
description:
In a world where you must steal or be stolen, kill or be killed, Ray, an orphan from the 50th sector, possesses the unique ability to see mana in the form of colors. However, despite the colorful sparks that fill the world around him, his existence has been numb detachment, completely devoid of emotions. But when a life-altering event shatters the cold, unfeeling life he once knew, Ray's journey might just unfold into a story richer in color than he could have ever imagined.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: My Sister Picked Up The Male Lead

synonyms: 姐姐把男主角撿回家了
เมื่อพี่สาวเก็บพระเอกมาฝาก
Meine Schwester hat den Hauptcharakter aufgelesen
Mi Hermana Recogió Al Protagonista Masculino
Mi hermana trajo al protagonista a casa
姉が男主人公を拾ってきた
description:
Amy is currently living a pleasant life as a character in a novel she read in her previous life. She already knows how the story goes, so when her sister gifts her a strange boy she found in the Night Woods for her 16th birthday, she panics. He is none other than Lennox Iberich, the male lead who lost his memories. And now that they’ve met, Amy will either have to accept her own death that's been foretold or do what she can to change the ending of her story.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: Secretly More Powerful than the Hero

synonyms: แกร่งเกินผู้กล้า แต่ซ่าไม่ได้
I Was More Overpowered Than the Hero, so I Hid My Power!
description:
From a young age, I've always dreamed of being that “unassuming hero,” appearing ordinary but possessing unmatched strength. But one day, fate took a turn when I was hit by an eight-ton truck, and suddenly, reincarnation was on the table! "What would you like to be in your next life?" asked the goddess of reincarnation. Eagerly, I replied, "I wish to become a wimp, but secretly OP!” She granted my wish, but with an unexpected twist: if anyone ever uncovers my true abilities, my heart will explode! This isn't quite the “secretly-OP-wimp-life” I had in mind…

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: They Say I Was Born a King's Daughter

synonyms: 転生したら王女様になりました
description:
After spending most of her youth fielding the attention of countless wealthy suitors, Suhee Kim finally finds true love with a steady boyfriend named Jinsu Han. But then tragedy strikes, and Suhee is murdered in cold blood.

To Suhee's surprise, she is immediately reincarnated as a baby girl named Sanghee Kim, who just so happens to be a princess! Plus, she is fully conscious of her past life. There's just one problem: in this society, women are seen as totally inferior, even princesses. Appalled by the treatment of women, Sanghee is determined to change the kingdom's patriarchal ways. Will Sanghee be able to succeed, or will she be stuck living her second life being treated as a lowly woman?

(Source: Boom Manga)

title.english: Daisy: How to Become the Duke's Fiancée

synonyms: Deijii: Koushaku no Fianse ni Naru Houhou
デイジー～公爵の婚約者になる方法～
เดซี่ ขอเป็นคู่หมั้นให้ท่านดยุก
description:
Sweet, timid Daisy meets a tragic end after being betrayed by the man she loves. When she is given a second chance at life, she vows not to repeat the same mistakes of the past! The only problem is that she must pay off her father’s gambling debt to Kilian, an aristocrat with a terrifying reputation. One option will take her 60 years, and the other, just three... but it involves a contract marriage to Kilian, who must be three years married in order to inherit the title of duke. While Daisy has sworn off men, the conditions of the offer are too good to pass up. She will be paid a generous amount of money at the end of the contract and also be guaranteed a swift divorce. Is she making a mistake by putting her trust in another man? Or will this deal give her the wings she needs to fly?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

characters.description: Second born daughter of the Filberun family

description:
Seowoo, president of the film club, is standing outside in the rain, a welcome break from the noisy and chaotic bar behind her, when a girl with orange hair stumbles out the doors and practically into her arms. Then she begins singing “Dancing in the Rain” while... dancing in the rain. It’s a minute encounter, really, but Seowoo has seen the greatest romances bloom from the smallest moments in the movies. So when Hayoung shows up to join the film club, Seowoo – who’s not even sure what she herself is feeling – finds her heart skipping a beat.

(Source: Lezhin)

characters.description: She is a college student double majoring in Accounting and Journalism and it's the president of the Cine.So film club.
She is a freshman college student who joins the Cine.So film club.

description:
For Paula, not a single day passed by without a reminder of her ugliness. But it was her hideous face that spared her from being sold to a brothel or dying tragically like her sisters. So when Paula's father sells her off to work at an esteemed nobleman's mansion, she realizes that peasant girls are a disposable resource. However, she finds the young Count Belunita tucked away in an annex, shamefully hidden from the curious eyes of the public. And as Paula struggles to appeal to her tyrannical master's whims, she must also embrace her role as his secret maid.

(Source: WEBTOON)

What if an unexpected accident suddenly transported you back to ten years ago? For Hayoung, suddenly traveling back in time to high school means the opportunity to save the life of Jaehyun, the one person she's always loved... Will she be able to change both of their fates?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

synonyms: The Essence Of A Perfect Marriage
The Perfect Way To Get Married
วิวาห์ลวงชวนให้รัก
description:
Iju Han isn’t sure where her life went wrong. Once the heiress to a wealthy business magnate, she’s now an ordinary housewife whose main concerns are her nagging in-laws and household chores. Things take a much more tragic turn, however, when she finds her husband confessing his love to her stepsister. Devastated, she runs away, only to be hit by a car and killed. But when she opens her eyes, she finds that she’s awakened a year ago in the past, before her life went awry. Given a second chance at life, Iju vows revenge, determined to take back all that she’s lost.

(Source: WEBTOON)

synonyms: My Time Was Limited So I Became the Villain's Daughter in Law
ฉันกลายเป็นลูกสะใภ้จำกัดเวลาของตัวร้าย
Because She Had A Time Limit, She Became The Villain’s Daughter-in-law
description:
After losing her parents, Laria Losstree is saddled with a mountain of bills. Enter the archvillain, Duke Icardes, who agrees to pay off her debt, but only if she’ll marry his son, Evan. Cool and distant, he’s not exactly ideal husband material, but that’s okay, since Laria plans to secretly stash his money, then bounce! But when the duke starts acting suspiciously nice to her, Laria begins to wonder if he's on to her plan, and a battle of wits between archvillain and daughter-in-law begins!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 19 extra chapters.

characters.description: The one and only heir of Duke Icardes. Laria's husband.

description:
Unrivaled looks, extraordinary skills, a clear path to the throne—Sienna Argent has it all. And now she’s even seeing visions of her future! Everything is set for her as the Silver King and soon-to-be emperor... So why has she suddenly grown wary of those around her? The mother she’s always seen as her ally, the half-royal half-brother she’s constantly shunned, and a man shrouded in mystery, all seem to play a hand in the course of her future. Is Sienna destined for a less than happy ending?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

title.english: I Will Fall With The Emperor

synonyms: I Will Fall With The Emperor
お求め頂いた暴君陛下の悪女です
おめいただいた暴君陛下の悪女です
description:
“You, too, will be corrupted. Then I will make it all come true.”

If I had only joined hands with him and agreed to become his mistress then, could I have lived a little longer? At least I would not have know the pain of my eyes being gouged out. But instead I shouted: “I refuse. I will not betray my country”, not realizing that my country, my family, had betrayed me long ago.

Sacrificed, used, abandoned, and finally executed by my own family... I only realized after returning to 10 years in the past that the reason why you wanted me to stand by your side is because you and I were so much alike.
Let us fall together this time.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: Won first place in the Tateyomi Manga Awards 2025 domestic category.

Remi Do has everything - she's super pretty, has the best brand sponsorships on social media, and gets 10,000 likes within seconds of posting a selfie. Oh, and she also has a serial-killing stalker following her every move.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

characters.description: Remi Do has pale skin and long, black hair, and hazel/grey eyes. She is seen in many outfits, one being a long white dress. She is seen to be covered in blood for major parts of the story, and despite her current fame online, she has been abused, stalked, and attacked before.

title.english: The Reason She Lives as a Villainess

synonyms: Why She Lives as a Villainess
目覚めたら悪女でした
เหตุผลของคนร้ายๆ
description:
Some people would jump at the chance at a new life, but when Jeongyun wakes up after a terrible accident and finds that she has become Lecian Fucernien, a character of a cliche, romantic fantasy novel, it feels like she’s woken up inside a nightmare. Disappointed as she is, she quickly accepts her fate and decides to make the best of her new life. The good news is that Lecian's character has a happy ending, but the bad news is that she's supposed to die once to get it. Between foiling her abusive new father’s plans of committing treason, finding a way out of her engagement to the crown prince, and avoiding the strange duke who seems to be stalking her, Jeongyun has a very long to-do list. Will Jeongyun be able to adjust to her new life while figuring out a way to avoid dying a second time?

(Source: Tappytoon)

synonyms: The Time I Wished You Were Dead
description:
King Karloi of Croisen finds himself at odds with his position in life. His wife’s father, Duke Deluah, is angling for the throne, and as an outsider to the family, Karloi fears for his position. His frustrations have affected his marriage, though he finds himself questioning his cold approach to his wife, Evonne. He may no longer recognize her, but Evonne saved his life long ago and was his first love. This is but one of many secrets Evonne bears the weight of, having fallen victim to a curse that prevents her from telling any secrets...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes an 8-chapter side story.

synonyms: ดวงใจจักรพรรดิ
description:
Bayan is an outcast amongst the Siyo, a people who have healing powers. Considered worthless because she doesn’t have the ability to heal others, Bayan is sent to the court of Dhan, the Great Sun Emperor, who is cursed with unrelenting bloodlust and slaughters his concubines mercilessly. It seems that Bayan’s fate is sealed the moment she reaches the emperor’s palace and Dhan is fated to suffer from madness forever... But together, Bayan and Dhan just might be able to change each other’s destiny.

(Source: Lezhin US)

synonyms: フリーシラーの結婚依頼
คำขอแต่งงานของพริสซิลลา
description:
Spunky mercenary mage Priscilla Mortia sets out on her final mission: to reclaim the last 15 years of her tragic life. Using a mana stone called the Dragon Heart, she travels back in time to when her family ruled over the land. While Priscilla’s goal is to reawaken her magical powers by obtaining the Dragon Heart in the past, she must survive the sinister plots of her wicked stepmother and her elderly fiance. To aid in her quest she seeks out Kian Lustin, a renowned swordsman who once captured her heart. But why does their fateful first meeting seem strangely familiar? Can Priscilla finally gain Kian's allegiance and claim her rightful seat as the heir to House Mortia?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: The Newlywed Diary of a Witch and a Dragon

synonyms: The Newly-Wed Life of a Witch and a Dragon
El diario de la bruja y el dragón
La lune de miel de la sorcière et du dragon
Von der Hexe, die einen Drachen heiratete
Crónicas matrimoniales de una bruja y un dragón
description:
After spending the night with a recent hire of the Tower of Magic, Wendy Blanchett, a talented young leader of the Rune Research Division, is faced with an impossible dilemma. She fears for her position and reputation when the newbie, Aiden Winters, asks her to marry him. Unbeknownst to Wendy, Aiden seems to have secrets of his own. Will their love blossom, or will his secrets tear them apart?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: A talented Junior at The Tower, worked at the Arcane Crystal Research, but temporarily transferred to the Rune Research Division later on. He’s a member of the most powerful species on the planet which are dragons. Aiden Winter is specifically a black dragon.
Head of the Rune Research Division, Star pupil of Archwizard Shakma, and the main character of the series.
Renowned Archwizard, the head of The Tower of Magic, a magic research institution sanctioned by the Kingdom of Mornada.

synonyms: It’s My Destiny To Be The Hero’s Saviour
Destined to be the Savior of the Protagonist
I'm Destined to Be the Savior of the Male Lead
ชะตาลิขิตให้ฉันเป็นผู้ช่วยชีวิตตัวเอก
description:
After years of torture at the hands of her own father, young elementalist Ariadne Eldier sees her chance to escape when her mother’s untimely death prompts a visit from her grandfather, a powerful archmage. Once whisked away to safety, Aria begins her plans to not only distribute an elixir for the contamination plaguing the land, but also save the protagonist and prevent this novel’s tragic ending. But with her own fated death looming, will Aria be able to become the hero this tale needs?

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: จอมเวทนอกรีตแห่งหอคอยขาว
description:
Once the greatest mage and Grand Magus of the White Tower, Oscar Sage dies in a war against The Demon Emperor—only to awaken twenty years later as the disgraced noble, Oscar Crusian. The once-mighty White Tower lies in ruins, and rival factions hold control over military and resources. With his mana circuits sealed and former allies now enemies, Oscar must rebuild the White Tower, seek vengeance, and reclaim his power before the Mage Council exiles him for good. Will magic rise again or will it be buried forever?

(Source: WEBTOON)

synonyms: I Become a Fool When It Comes to My Daughter
今日も娘が可愛すぎます
description:
24-year-old Juwon Lee works part-time at a convenience store and lives alone in his small apartment. One day his uncle passes away and leaves behind a 4-year-old daughter, the cute little Yeondu. Instead of letting her be sent to an orphanage, Juwon steps up and decides to be her new guardian.

(Source: Manta)

Netkama – a male who portrays himself as female online. This is what Kim Seyeong decides to become after reencountering Shin Heejae, the guy who destroyed Seyeong’s gaming career in “Arcadia” a year prior. His plan is to pretend to be a girl in the game, get Heejae to fall for him, and then make the big reveal to everyone so that his archnemesis will also be humiliated out of “Arcadia” forever. But being a dude trying to become the girlfriend of your worst enemy is no easy feat, especially more so when said worst enemy starts to show a bit too much interest in you. Will Seyeong come out the victor of this scheme? Or will he find himself losing to Heejae all over again?

(Source: Tappytoon)

characters.description: __Height:__ 187cm
__Height:__ 178cm

synonyms: ชีวิตนักเรียนฉัน ขอคืนเถอะนะ
description:
Do you want a refund on your life? Start earning karma at The Refund High School to reincarnate as an ideal version of yourself.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

The genius lawyer No Hyeong-Jin's justice-executing returner fantasy! Valedictorian of his University, perfect score on the Bar Exam, and even a 95% case win rate. No Hyeong-Jin was a so-called successful lawyer! While he was fighting against evil, higher powers to make South Korea a just and fair land, he was ruthlessly murdered by National Intelligence Service agents.

"He shouldn't have died..."

No Hyeong-Jin was a man sent by Emperor Yeom-Ra to fix corruption on Earth! However, after ending up in hell without having been able to achieve anything, Emperor Yeom-Ra returns No Hyeong-Jin back in time...  What is this "power" given to him by Emperor Yeom-Ra? Will No Hyeong-Jin be able to change his future as well as the future of South-Korea?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Oh no... my ex-boyfriend lives next door?! Excited to start a new chapter in her life as an adult, Hye-Jin gets caught off guard when she finds out that her first love Hae-Jun -- whom she dumped five years ago -- is her new next door neighbor and fellow classmate at the same university! Still dazed and confused about love and dating, will Hye-Jin learn how to navigate her relationships with certainty and confidence and not get sidetracked by what others think?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

synonyms: From a Lady to the Queen
บัลลังก์แค้นจักรพรรดินี
description:
Betrayed by someone she held dear, Rizi's previous life ended with the fall of the guillotine... or it would have. Rizi awakens to find herself three years in the past, back before her life turned for the worse, back before people she thought she knew changed right before her eyes. Rizi won't be blinded again. This time, she'll cut tragedy off at the source.

(Source: Tapas)

Two twin brothers. Two opposite lives. In a world where loyalties are tested, alliances crumble, and moral ambiguities plague every decision, an elite HID agent discards his identity, becoming his twin brother - the boss of a major syndicate in Seoul. Gear up and step into the boots of Agent Baek and explore the twists in his gripping tale of blood and vengeance.

(Source: WEBTOON)

One hundred years after mosquitoes have evolved into the strongest predators on Earth, only 5,000 humans remain. Mankind’s last hope -- an elite team of special soldiers -- races to save the day. Will they obtain the secret research that may give humanity a fighting chance against the mosquitoes before it's too late?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

characters.description: The youngest ever to be admitted into the Special Operations Unit, she does reconnaissance for CETHCO. As the only survivor of the Wasteland Area, she was rescued by Hershey when she was just 12 years old.
A close combat expert and legendary mosquito killer, as he fought a group of them 10000 to 1 and won.
CETHCO unit leader. Graduated from the Mosquito War Military School. He is a strong leader.
CETHCO's Second In Command. He is gruff but can be a softie. Hates mosquitoes.
CETHCO's medic. She has excellent mental resistance and serves as Warhead's probation officer.
A former senior researcher for the Department of Defense, he now works as an engineer for CETHCO.

description:
When Manager Son is sent to a new department, his boring office life takes a sweet turn. There, he meets Manager An, an older colleague whose competence and charming aura leave him in awe. But as Manager Son grows closer to her, he realizes there’s more to her strong, independent front than meets the eye. And soon enough, he begins to understand why office crushes can get complicated.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

At first, Yona gave some major side-eye to the popular game "Concubine Walkthrough" until she got sucked into it—literally! Now stuck as the villain, she has her hands full facing the infamously cruel king, shaking off scheming concubines, and befriending NPCs. There’s only one way the Game Master will let her out and that’s to become the Queen! Will she be able to stay true to her honest and straightforward self despite the palace’s intrigues? One extra problem: she’s got competition...

(Source: Tapas)

When junior knight Roselyn is rescued from the bottom of a cliff after an ambush by an enemy kingdom, her brother Calix is relieved – that is, until he learns that she's lost her memory. Now, she behaves like a child, eats like a horse, and wields unbelievable strength. But something's not quite right...

(Source: Manta)

Twenty-one year old Yuna is tired of having guys hit on her all the time. As popular as she is, she's been single her whole life. Just when she decides to make herself a boyfriend to fend off guys, she meets a handsome guy who looks good enough to be her boyfriend. But wait, the guy is actually a girl! In fact, rumor says that Min is a lesbian. Nonetheless, the two decide to pretend to be in a romantic relationship.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Lee Giho is trying to earn his tuition through the popular VR game Circuit, but things just aren't going his way. However, right when he decides to throw in the towel, he gets a lucky break that changes everything. Fortune leads him ever deeper into the game’s lore, and before he knows it, Giho finds himself stocked up with powerful items chasing an elusive group of mysterious warriors. But to unlock his true powers, Giho must learn the secrets of this group before his luck runs out for good.

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: อสูรขย้ำบุปผา
野獣のような皇太子に愛されすぎてる
description:
"Could this all perhaps be Hwayeon's dream? Or did Yeonu create this fantasy world in her head to escape her harsh reality?"
Hwayeon Ryu, without knowing the cause, falls into a coma at the age of six. Then after 12 long years of her father, Chung Ryu's persistent attempts, she finally opens her eyes. As she wakens from her prolonged sleep, she realizes she not only has her memories but has the memories of someone else's life, Yeonu Lee. Though startled at first, as time passes, she manages to adjust to her new life. Then one day, in hope to have lunch with her father, she pays a visit to the palace. But she ends up taking the wrong turn and finds herself in front of the notorious beast, crown prince Muyeong...
The story unfolds then, when the soft and delicate flower Hwayeon meets the arrogant and fearless beast, Muyeong.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Includes 32 extra chapters.

Yulia Von Rosenthal gave everything she had to serve her liege and love, Emperor Leonard, but she was rewarded with betrayal and death because of her "ugly" appearance, the result of an age-long family curse. Just when she thinks everything is over, Yulia finds herself alive, eight years before her death. Determined not to repeat her past mistakes, she ventures out on a journey to break her curse and become stronger. The question is, will that be enough for Yulia to escape Leonard's clutches?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: To save her from a curse killing her, Julia learns the art of the Frozen Sword. This comes at a cost, however, as it curses her with an ugly appearance until she can master it.

synonyms: Again My Life คืนชีพ คืนยุติธรรม
description:
A righteous prosecutor, life reset, punish the villain!!!!

A hot-blooded prosecutor, Kim Hi Wu, was murdered and sunk into the ocean while chasing the tyrant who controlled korea. But, Kim Hi Wu, meets a grim reaper who gives him a chance to relive and sends him back to when he was 18 years old. As a high schooler, Kim Hi Wu, prepares to punish the tyrant Jo Tae Sup.

“To get the devil, you have to become one”

Soyou, who was a promising track and field athlete, lost everything due to acute heart disease. She was sentenced to death but miraculously survives with a heart donation. She loses everything she had built up and returns to high school a year later than her peers, but it is not easy for her to make friends or pursue her dreams. Then, in the new semester of the second year, the moment she sees a boy in the classroom, her heart suddenly races, and she feels like crying... The man she met in her dream that night introduces himself as the owner of the transplanted heart and the father of the boy she saw for the first time today. Isn't that something? His son, Jaeha, has lost his entire family and is alone in this world... At the man's request, Soyou gives Jaeha a message of support, and with each action, precious people are found in Soyou's empty life—reasons for life, relationships, and dreams. Soyou progresses slowly, but one by one, she learns how to live.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: Includes 23 extra chapters.

characters.description: __Height__: 169 cm
__Height__: 183 cm
__Height__: 155 cm
__Height__: 155 cm

synonyms: I Became the First Prince: Legend of Sword's Song
เมื่อดาบมารได้เป็นเจ้าชาย
description:
The dark blade Gruhorn, constant companion to heroes throughout the ages. Knights, rebels, and slayers—all became legend wielding this sentient blade. But, centuries after being claimed by the first hero, Gruhorn winds up in the clutches of his descendant: a greedy, greasy, bratty lout of a first prince. Even worse: when the prince falls onto the blade, Gruhorn becomes him! But is this new body a prison, or a chance for the legendary blade to become a hero himself?

(Source: Tapas)

He’s a dark, uber-powerful god-level demon…who’s also really helpful around the house. Welcome to the unique world of Ghost Wife, where an average high school girl can go to sleep with normal teenage problems, only to wake up and find herself married to an over-protective demon with a creepy smile and an appetite for live cats.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

synonyms: The Art of Taming a Tiger
กระดิ่งล่าวิญญาณ
description:
Yoon-Jae is just a normal college student who lives alone...until his new neighbor, Beom-jin, moves in one floor below him. Then, things get weird. Namely, Yoon-Jae starts seeing ghosts everywhere, and they start stalking him. Turns out, a mysterious bell that belongs to Beom-jin is now tied to Yoon-Jae's wrist, and it summons ghosts wherever he goes. Unable to remove the cursed thing, Beom-jin suggests that Yoon-Jae help out with his work until they find a way to remove it. Oh, what kind of work? Sending ghosts to the afterlife, of course.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

characters.description: __Height:__ 189.7 cm
__Height:__ 177.5 cm

title.english: The Perfect Plan for a Fairy-Tale Ending
title.romaji: Donghwa Sok Agyeogui Wanbyeokan Ending Plan
title.native: 동화 속 악역의 완벽한 엔딩 플랜

synonyms: Donghwa Sok Agyeogui Wanbyeokan Ending Plan
동화 속 악역의 완벽한 엔딩 플랜
A Perfect Ending Plan of the Villain in a Fairy Tale
The Perfect Ending for the Villainess of a Fairy Tale
反派也想要有完美結局
แผนตอนจบสุดสมบูรณ์ของตัวร้ายในเทพนิยาย
description:
Once upon a time, Lalisa Blick was abused by her family, who wanted to take her diamond tears for themselves. Then one day, a prince appeared to save Lalisa and ride off into the sunset with her. But why was I reborn into this fairy tale as the evil sister, Marcia?! I need to leave this wretched house... but how can I leave my poor sister here in this hell hole? Instead of waiting for the prince to come, I can just bring Lalisa to him. This way, both of us can live happily ever after, right?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

Kang Chan and Seyeon have been close friends since they were young after being introduced by their parents. After entering high school, Seyeon suddenly received a confession from Kang Chan and became aware of Kang Chan since then. Meanwhile, Naeun is displeased with their relationship. The trivial and noisy story of their love triangle and those around them...

Chiu Kang, known online as Kang Chi, is one of the best players in DC. To him, the real world feels dull and inefficient, so he pours everything into mastering the game. Yet... even at the top, life feels hollow. That all changed one day on his way home from the internet café. After a sudden accident, he wakes up not as Chiu Kang—but as Kella Caldern, the Demon King’s son.

(Source: Tapas)

Former ranker Lee Hoyeon is looking to make it big in the new VR game, "Labyrinth World." He isn't about to get his hands dirty doing all the work, so how about recruiting someone else to get things done? Enter Kaiser and Lina, his new henchmen. They've got the skills, the brawn, and... a thirst for blood! Kaiser and Lina will take down anyone standing in their boss's way, but as the bodies pile up, Hoyeon starts to wonder if his lackeys aren't just insanely strong, but rather flat-out insane!

(Source: Tapas)

Life isn’t always perfect, but love certainly makes it better. The exciting tale of young love continues a year following the story “Seasons of Blossom.” Bo-Mi and her university classmate Pu-Reum’s lives center around a new place, “Cafe Blossom & Nemone Art Studio,” as they navigate the joy and hardships of university and professional life.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

characters.description: **Height:** 174cm **Family:** [Ha-Min](https://anilist.co/character/210939/HaMin-Lee) and So-Min's brother. [Yoon-Jung](https://anilist.co/character/346480/YoonJung-Choi) and Seong-Geun's son. He's the male lead of [Cheongchun Lovesome](https://anilist.co/manga/181542/Cheongchun-Lovesome/). [Bo-Mi](https://anilist.co/character/210937/BoMi-Yun)'s classmate.

Jin-Yeong is a quiet person that's often deemed as rude because of his straightforwardness. He's good at games and is strangely popular among the guys in school that like to play too. He has two younger siblings that are very different from him, although they all look alike. ~!Jin-Yeong overheard [Bo-Mi](https://anilist.co/character/210937/BoMi-Yun) confessing that she liked him, and they started dating in secret.!~

[Bo-Mi](https://anilist.co/character/210937/BoMi-Yun)'s best friend and [Jae-Min](https://anilist.co/character/210938/JaeMin-Lee)'s childhood friend.

__Height__: 178 cm **Family** : Three sisters : Mi-Hyeon, Joo-Hyeon and [Da-Hyeon](https://anilist.co/character/346482/DaHyeon-Kim) Sun-Hui is the male lead of Seasons of Blossom autumn arc. [Jae-Min](https://anilist.co/character/210938/JaeMin-Lee)'s friend.

title.english: The Secret of the Partner Next to You

synonyms: The Secret of the Partner Next to You
The Secret of my Next Classmate
description:
Yang Kiryong is an ordinary high school boy who has a classmate named Yoo Jae-Kyung, who is somewhat clumsy and clueless. Both have a very good friendship, but without any kind of love attraction. Until one day, by chance, Kiryong discovered the deepest secret of his friend and because of this his heart began to beat, will it be beats of fear or love?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

After saving Terra from the demon king, Yoo Seung-Woo came back to Earth with just one goal: open a restaurant and serve his customers Terra's dishes! The catch? Said dishes are made from monster parts and are mostly disgusting. On top of that, his return ends up drawing the government's attention and attracting otherworldly monsters to his planet! In the midst of all the chaos, will this hero manage to fulfill his goal while keeping his business and the world intact?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

characters.description: __Occupation:__ Owner of Hero's Diner

description:
Some people thirst for power while others want nothing more than to live low. Ha-Min has always been resentful of the label that comes with being his father’s son—he didn’t ask to be born into a mob family! After much trial and error, Ha-Min finally breaks ties with his family and begins to live the life he's dreamed about. That is, until he gets kidnapped and finds himself under the protection of a certain Kwon Se-Hyeok. All Ha-Min wants is his "normal" life back, but Se-Hyeok is as far from normal as a person can get...

(Source: Lezhin US)

The world has changed and so have the people.

December 31st, 2016 – the day before New Year's. Kim Taehoon was just casually shopping for groceries at the large store. Monsters suddenly appeared out of thin air. With the highly trained skills that he had gained from his previous occupation, he starts to hunt the monsters down and manages to win, saving countless people who were also at the mall.

But there are more and they don't stop coming.
Will he be able to survive until the end?
Will he be able to beat the countless monsters that only seem to get stronger?
And will it just be monsters that he has to worry about?

The journey of Kim Taehoon, The First Hunter, begins.

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

Bo-Mi is the prettiest girl in school, and she wants to live at my house! Has springtime finally come for me at last?

(Source: Toomics, edited)

characters.description: Note: In the English version she has blonde hair, while in the Korean one she has black hair.
Matthew's bestfriend.

title.english: Crawling My Way to the Top!

synonyms: I Will Raise This Family to Greatness
I Will Raise This Family Up
description:
With money, looks, and a successful career, Seongguk has it all. That is, until he dies and is reborn as a baby! To make things worse, his new parents are dead broke. However, alongside his new loving family, Seongguk soon learns that perhaps some things are better than money... not! He's going to have loving parents and money in this life, and there's no better time to start than now. Armed with an adorable face and the skills of a business tycoon, can Seongguk take his new family to the top?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Being Loved for the First Time

synonyms: First Time as a Loved Youngest Child
It's My First Time Being Loved
第一次成為受寵小女兒
愛され末っ子は初めてで
ครั้งแรกกับการเป็นลูกคนเล็กผู้ได้รับความรัก
A Caculinha da Familia Nunca Teve Amor Assim
description:
After sacrificing herself to save the world over 99 different lifetimes, Anastasia Enderblanc starts her 100th life with frustrated resignation. Born as the youngest child of House Enderblanc, she expects another abusive family that fears her power, but is confused when they shower her with love instead. Their genuine affection surprises her, but she keeps waiting for the other shoe to drop. Can Anastasia accept the Enderblancs' love, or will she be disappointed and betrayed once more?

(Source: Tapas)

Humans live in the Overworld and Demons in the Underworld. There is only one way for humans to travel between the worlds.

Mankind's last hope: WARBLE.

(Source: Toomics)

characters.description: Main Character of Warble. A Cloud of mysteries surround him. He has a special ability to memorize anything - be It language, abilities, how to play an instrument etc. upon seeing It once. He saves a young girl who he then makes her his servant.

title.english: There Are No Bad Warriors in This World

synonyms: There Are No Bad Heroes in This World
description:
Hyeonseok Choi finally becomes the undisputed heavyweight MMA champion of the world, but gets hit by a truck, and dies. A fairy, Rahel, appears and convinces him to fight as a hero in the afterlife, but accidentally sends him to the side of the demons. Stuck in the demon world, he sweet talks his way into positions of power, but slowly discovers this battle between good and evil isn't as clearcut as it seems.

(Source: WEBTOON)

What happens when you lose the one thing that you were the best in the world at? Ji-Ho Seong was once a top-ranked player in the online action game, One Sword. When the game eventually shuts down due to a lack of players, he loses all interest in competitive gaming. That is, until he finds out that his school has an e-sports club and discovers a popular team-based game called Sword Rush, which seems to be an exact copy of One Sword. With new teammates now by his side, Ji-Ho takes another shot at rising to the top of the game!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

characters.description: Ji-Ho was once a top-ranked player in the online action game, One Sword.

description:
The peak of strength in South Korea is the Esteemed Martial Lee Clan. In that martial clan, Lee Cheol was looked down on and chased out because of his status as an illegitimate child. In order to survive, he lived in shadows, but he was chased down and killed because of his family's schemes. He was then granted a second chance—regression. Using his "ability to absorb the memories of a weapon" as a foundation, Lee Cheol would train and go down a path of struggle. Persistent competition and schemes regarding the right to inheritance, attacks from other races and monsters in dangerous, unexplored lands, and even local clashes related to his family's internal struggles... His growth would bring about these things, bringing hardship upon Lee Cheol. Life itself would be a struggle for Lee Cheol, and this is his destiny. But in order to protect himself and his surroundings—in order to protect everything—as the fight continues, he'll unravel secrets from his past life, one by one...!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Qi, swords, martial artists… and robots and spaceships?! The year is 3077, thousands of years after the heyday of the martial arts realm. Humanity inhabits the stars, governed by interstellar martial arts organizations who kept the old ways of the realm alive: might makes right! For bounty hunters like Seryeong, Robert, and Sunja, this means trouble is good for business, except when they bite off more than they can chew. After venturing to the irradiated wasteland of Earth for a top bounty, only to find a 2,000-year-old martial artist instead, they realize their fortunes are about to change…

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: Lee Mok-Jin is protagonist of the story, who was found by Se-Ryeong and her partners in the desolated Earth. After awaking from his long isolated sleep, he travels beyond Earth with them into space. It is known that around 2000 years ago he voluntarily sealed himself in an underground Stone Chamber of the Mount Tai Star System on Earth. He was unmatched in his era being the Supreme Heavenly Demon.

Se-Ryeong is the leader of a group of bounty hunters known as S-Devil. When they reach Earth, they go into the underground to search for any living signals. She finds the ancient underground stone where Lee Mok-Jin resided. She is the female main character beside Lee Mok-Jin and her team. She has impressive martial skills for her age and is known to have connections throughout the Space. ~!Later it was found that she is a direct descendant of the Tang Family, which was supposedly annihilated 10 years ago.!~
Sunja is a member of the S-Devil bounty hunters. Pilot of the crew and is known to be very intelligent and knowledgeable including information space machines and analysis of life forms.

Robert is also a member of S-Devil. It was he along with Se-Ryeong who found the underground Stone where Mok-Jin resided. He comes from the hometown of planet Mount Hua. He is a former sergeant of the Northern Galaxy Combat Unit’s Special Tactical Division.

synonyms: เกิดอีกที ขอเป็นคนดีได้ไหม(วะ)?
description:
Age 41, Oh Jung-Seok. A man who did all kinds of misdeeds and put his life on the line for the organisation to gain the highest position. But who knew the end of his life would be so miserable… Jung-Seok’s ‘virtuous living’ project starts now, one by one.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Seol Moo-dok, a master of Hyeon-gyeong who became the lord of the North Sea Ice Palace at the age of four, was in a state of sorrow after his lover died. He realized that his dead lover was reincarnated through the legendary flower, Yeonri-hwa, and wandered around until he fell into another world...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: The Fake Lady and Her Rabbit Duke

description:
Grand Duke Hadelrune de Strelitz is the hero of the empire and Lady Zernoa de Rhanterra is the “golden flower” of high society. What commonalities could they share besides their glowing reputations? Apparently, secrets. One day, Zernoa comes across an unassuming pile of clothes under which she is startled to find an adorable rabbit who also happens to be… Grand Duke Hadelrune. An ancient family curse and a fictitious upbringing… What else could these two be hiding?!

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: How To ดัดนิสัยมาร์ควิสจอมคลั่ง
description:
Laranora Ador gets more than she bargained for when she rescues a young boy from being sold off in an infamous auction house. The boy is actually Eskal Van Dyck, the "Crazy Marquess," in disguise! Unaware of his violent and heartless true nature, Laranora takes Eskal under her wing. Determined to raise him with utmost care and respect, Laranora grows deeply attached to Eskal… and in return, the true Eskal begins to fall in love with her. Unfortunately, Eskal is often targeted for his powerful magic and ruthless ways, which leads to a tragic event that separates the two. But Eskal is determined to find her again as his true self. Will Laranora be able to accept who he really is? And more importantly, what will happen when something fishy brewing in the Imperial Palace may involve them both?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Yu Ji-Tae, a regressor with unparalleled power. Even with that power and repeated regressions, he was unable to prevent the destruction of Earth. The cause of this destruction was four baby dragons who came to Earth to play. The story of a man who, rather than possessing absolute power, seeks to protect them and prevent destruction.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

characters.description: He is the strongest human in the world, but when four young dragons are forced to come to Earth due to interference from the mastermind, the Earth is destroyed.
A green dragon with the power of prophecy, and the eldest of four sisters.
A blue dragon, the polar opposite of the red dragon, and the youngest of four sisters.
A red dragon of the warrior race, the second eldest of four sisters. She has a strong obsession with strength.
A gold dragon and the third of four sisters. She has a strong obsession with beauty and human attention.

description:
Leah Hildebrandt, who is known for her good looks and popularity, has a secret she can not share with a soul. Rihit, her younger brother, runs away hoping to come back a stronger man who can support his family. Their father passes away in his absence and he still cannot be found. Leah finds herself face-to-face with the reality that she will need to act as the temporary head of her family in order to protect their position in society. So, she makes the decision to enter into a political marriage for her family. Will a political choice turn out to be fate?

(Source: Netcomics)

synonyms: I Stack Experience Through Reading Books
この本は僕の経験値を生んだ
description:
Jongsuk is the pinnacle of mediocrity, with nothing to show for himself except his penchant for reading. One day, he finds a mysterious book at his favorite used book store. The book "tells" him to write about his experience in its blank pages, and in return shows him a related piece of information. Little did he know, the passages Jongsuk read in the books transferred right into his system, endowing with new abilities he never thought possible.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Friend versus friend. Grand Master pitted against noob. Self-confident alpha high schooler meets loner who may or may not be a gaming savant capable of defeating everyone he plays. All this and more comes together on the battlefield of PSI BOND – the hottest online game in the world played by the coolest kids in Korea. High speed connections and high school will never be the same again.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

characters.description: Also known as his username Psychopomp, Do-Yun is a timid, ordinary schoolboy. He doesn't have a gaming computer, used to play on laggy American servers, but still managed to beat everyone at PSI BOND, despite barely knowing anything about the game. His primary position is attack (DPS) but he plays best as a sniper.

She has a big crush on Su-Ho and will do anything to hang out with him, but he keeps blowing her off for Do-Yun. She is the most popular girl in the school thanks to her looks but she still remains hung up on Su-Ho. She volunteers to, and eventually becomes team manager of team Deathperado along with Bonnie.

Su-Ho is a Grandmaster rank at this online game called PSI BOND. He sneaks away in the middle of school to play it in the computer lab, and notices another mysterious student doing the same thing. This kid is a far lower level than he is, so Su-Ho believes that he will easily beat the new kids in a few rounds. When he loses 0 to 10, he begins to realize that there is something special about this kid. That kid, is Do-Yoon Lee.

title.english: I Dream of Health, Wealth, and a Long Life

synonyms: The Goal Is to Become a Gold Spoon so I Need to Be Completely Invulnerable
description:
Lady Adrianna isn't just a noblewoman, she's the side character in "Ramona's Tale," the favorite novel of an ill peasant girl who died tragically young. This is her second chance at life, and she's not reliving that tragedy! An evil stepmother's not gonna stop her, and Rian slowly gathers handsome companions along the way... the calculating imperial prince, the friendly count, the mysterious and brooding demon prince. After all, she is determined to live a long, healthy, and wealthy life!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: I've been Proposed to by a Villain

synonyms: I Got Married to a Villain
悪役に求婚されました
description:
After transmigrating into a novel, Regina Blois is certain of one fact: she is destined to die at the hands of the crazed duke Arsene Graroy after witnessing him murder a political enemy of the empire. And it seems history is doomed to repeat itself as she, despite her best efforts, witnesses the murder again! Duke Arsene has every reason to kill her. So why is he instead proposing??

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

synonyms: The Duchess of the Glass Greenhouse
description:
Rayna Vinosht was always known as the cursed one. Unloved by her father, she’s married off to the handsome Duke Edgar Heathvilian, but he soon becomes cold to her, taking away her son, and giving him to the seductive Monica Espert. But Rayna has a second chance at life thanks to Ondine, an adorable water spirit, who forms a contract with her. Soon Rayna has supernatural powers and the confidence to rule over her estate like a strong duchess, but what will happen now that Edgar is falling in love with her?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: My Husband Who Hates Me Has Lost His Memories

synonyms: My Husband Hates Me, But He Lost His Memories
สามีที่เกลียดข้าสูญเสียความทรงจำ
My Resentful Husband Lost His Memories
恨我的老公失去了記憶
description:
In a politically arranged marriage devoid of love, Lily is wed to Theodore, the head of a rival family. Theodore loathes the union, but little does he know that Lily despises her own family as much as he does. Living a quiet life, she counts the days until their inevitable divorce. Then fate intervenes—a sudden accident erases Theodore’s memories of her, transforming his coldness into unexpected affection. Can Lily trust this dramatic shift, or must she guard her heart to avoid future heartbreak?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

Sangun, the tiger lord of Baek Mountain, was living a peaceful life until a young, white-haired girl named Choa visits his cave, claiming to be his bride. Sangun immediately realizes that Choa is a descendant of the White-blooded Demon Beast, a dangerous creature feared by all spirits and beasts. He tries to send her away for fear of the dangers she will bring, but changes his mind upon discovering that she has nowhere to go. Unfortunately for him, this marks the beginning of his hardships...

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: ขอจุกนมให้หนูหน่อย
description:
Betrayed and executed by her pupil, magician Hela Sylopia finds herself in the body of the neglected infant granddaughter of a rivaling nation’s duke. To make matters worse, her family doesn’t remember her name, and the maids don’t care what happens to her! But when she discovers that having her pacifier in her mouth can expand her mind, Hela uses that to her advantage to survive, get rid of those who stand in her way, and start plotting her revenge. Will Hela succeed, or will she wish she’d never been given a second chance?

(Source: Tapas)

Would you sacrifice your honor to marry a Duke?

In order to save her family from ruin, Chloe Verdier must find a groom for her sister, Alice. She soon runs into the handsome but arrogant Duke Tisse who makes a proposal that could save them. When Alice flees with a mysterious man, Chloe must seek out the Duke in the biggest gamble of her life.

(Source: Manta)

synonyms: The Law of Being Friends With a Male
description:
Ji-Un's first romance ends when her crush, Jae-I, confesses that he likes someone else. To make matters worse, Jae-I mistakenly believes that Ji-Un's crush is his scary-looking best friend, Seo-Hyeon, and tries to help her win him over. Now, Ji-Un must deal with a bigger problem than her unrequited crush, the boy-friend she had never imagined getting close to.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

characters.description: [Bo-Ra](https://anilist.co/character/313325/)'s little sister.

synonyms: ก็อบลินเลเวล 999
description:
Cheol-Su is a loser in life and a loser in-game... until he’s suddenly promoted to Goblin Summoner. He’s shocked when he discovers that his goblin summon is a hideous, max-level monster capable of obliterating any foe with a single attack! There’s just one catch, though--his new buddy can’t be unsummoned, and it draws way too much attention. Now stuck with an overpowered pet following him everywhere, he has to get crafty and channel his inner goblin to manipulate and claw his way to the top in pursuit of greatness and riches.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Chan-U finds it difficult talking to Seol-Hui, who always seems to be angry about something. However, what he says to her actually makes her heart beat like crazy! A sweet, romantic  story of a young couple's first love!

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

characters.description: __Height__: 162 cm
__Height__: 179 cm

description:
So-Ru is a princess born from illegitimacy, and able to see ghosts although she is completely blind. Ja-Hyeon is a heroic general who possesses the sun’s aura which can chase away spirits. Ya-To is the deadliest and most beautiful ghost, but his heart can’t feel anything. So-Ru and Ja-Hyeon become bound to one another in an undesired marriage, but they both need each other –- she needs his aura, he needs her divine blood. As So-Ru's unconditional sacrifice and love toward Ja-Hyeon slowly melts his frozen heart, the same happens to Ya-To’s emotionless heart. All three have something that they need and want from one another. Could they become the salvation they need for one another?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Flower Dances and the Wind Sings

synonyms: The Flowers Dance and the Wind Sings
ดอกไม้เริงระบำและสายลมขับกล่อม
description:
As Ersella lies on her deathbed, she has only one regret: never being a good mother to her son, Vicente. When fate sends her back three years, she gets a chance to make things right. While reflecting on her past as a young bride and reluctant mother, Ersella begins to untangle years’ worth of heartache. But as familial, marital, and even political issues enter the picture, she realizes there’s more to her second life than she thought. Will Ersella’s change of heart be too little, too late?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: A young and intelligent woman who faces many tribulations as a mother and as duchess of a prominent household without much support. She wants to cherish her son that she neglected in the first timeline.

description:
There are animals that were abandoned by Dangun and live secretly in the human world. Narae, an ordinary high school student, discovers their existence... A modern version of Beauty and the Beast with comedy and exorcism action.

‘Will the project of becoming human, for the animals that could not become human, be successful?'

(Source: Naver, translated)

characters.description: A boy in Na-Rae's class, and a descendant of the animals who became half-humans. He saves Nara from a fox spirit attempting to take her soul, and afterwards he protects her as she becomes entangled in the supernatural world.

A descendant of hunters who finds herself entangled with ghosts, animals-turned-humans, and a fox spirit swearing vengeance on her lineage. She befriends a boy named Gyeon-U, after being saved by him.

title.english: Picture Book for the Demon Lord

synonyms: The Demon Lord and the Knight
Picture Book for the Demon Lord
마왕을위한 동화 -Der Erlkönig und der Ritter-
A Fairytale for the Demon Lord
description: A Demon Lord spirited the Princess away, and cursed her with eternal sleep. Countless knights sought to save her, only to die in vain by the Demon Lord's hands. But then, a Nameless Knight arrived to vanquish him and save the Princess, ignorant of what fate had in store for him...

characters.description: A Demon Lord who spirited the Princess away and cursed her with eternal sleep.
A mysterious knight with the will to overcome fate.

title.english: The Heavenly Demon Destroys the Lich King's Murim

synonyms: The Heavenly Demon Destroys the Lich King's Murim
description:
An unknown voice disturbed me while I was levitating during my cultivation to reach the transcendent demonic state.

My concentration had been broken, and I fell into an unconscious, overloaded state. When I awoke a month later, the Lich King had already taken control of the Murim.

After the battle that ended with the destruction of the Heavenly Demon Cult, I awoke a hundred and forty years later in a Murim where magic and martial arts coexisted.

When a swarm of giant bugs threatens to wipe out humanity, the world’s only defense is a group of humans with special abilities called Butterflies. For Maehwa Baek, Butterflies are just heroic people he sees on TV until a tragic event brings him to the scientists that created them. Soon, Maehwa must confront questions about himself that he has long avoided: why does he lose control at the sight of his own blood? And what happened during the 13 years of his life that he can’t remember?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: Ha-Jin Seo is the Second Butterfly of Garden.
Mae-Hwa Baek is the Fourth Butterfly of Garden and the main character of the series.
Jaeyon Shing is the First Butterfly of Garden.
Sara Lopez is a researcher at Garden.

description:
“Death is only the beginning.”

Truer words were never spoken for young Leon von Marbas, the heir to a once-great house of necromancers. Forced to execute his own father by the lord of a rival house, Leon suddenly finds himself the leader of a declining clan under threat from enemies within and without. The only way to restore the glory of his house? Leon must strike a pact with the demon Marbas, the original source of the powerful necromancy that House Marbas was once known for…

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

characters.description: The head of the Marbas family.

synonyms: ยูริกับกางเกงขาสั้นของราชินี
La culotte courte de la reine Cécia
異世界女王と転生デザイナー
異世界女王與轉生設計師
description:
With 99 nations conquered and the cup of the ruler in her hands... you'd think she was off to a heroic conquest, but the great queen's Cecia's real concern was her uncomfortable corset?

The queen of Valencia suffered from complicated laces and heavy corsets, and thus ordered her trusted brother, Duke Ennon Lionheart to bring her a comfortable clothes. Meanwhile, Yuri, a clothing designer was killed in an accident after suffering from a small minimum wage at a medium-sized clothing company in Korea. She was reborn in a renaissance country ruled by Cecia.

Yuri vowed to revolutionize the outdated clothing dilemma, so she dressed up as a man and worked as a designer at the top of the continent's highest court to do easy business. But... what happens when Ennon discover's Yuri's true identity...?

(Source: Comico, translated)

title.romaji: Heungmang Nampyeongwaui Ihone Silpaehan Geon Gatda
title.native: 흑막 남편과의 이혼에 실패한 것 같다

synonyms: Heungmang Nampyeongwaui Ihone Silpaehan Geon Gatda
흑막 남편과의 이혼에 실패한 것 같다
I Failed to Divorce My Husband
ดูเหมือนว่าฉันจะหย่ากับสามีตัวร้ายไม่สำเร็จ
似乎無法放棄這場婚姻
黒幕夫に惚れられました
description:
Ellen's plan is simple. Before turning into an obsessive villain who gets executed, she's going to get a divorce! But after she becomes Ellen Lianster, her plan gets complicated. Her new husband, Aiden, has developed a debilitating fear of being touched, and Ellen is determined to discover the cause and cure. As she finds ways to help him, an affection-deprived Aiden slowly begins to seek comfort from Ellen. With both hearts opening up to each other, can this marriage succeed... at failing?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

High-school student Dong-Jin Kim seems like a typical moody teenager, but underneath it all, he’s a powerful psychic “villain” who aims to destroy humanity. But there’s a catch -- every time he uses his powers to kill, he is thrown back in time. Trapped in this time loop, Dong-Jin tries to narrow down the culprit by doing the one thing he knows: killing those around him. Will he be able to escape from the time loop and achieve his goal as a villain?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

After half a year on the run, the vampire Eugene was ultimately killed, offered up as a sacrifice to boost a holy knight's fame. Just as his life ended in bitter regret, a chance to return came to him.

“I will never die like that again. If I’ve truly returned to the past, then I'll never regret anything a second time... no matter what it may take."

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: The World is Money and Power

synonyms: This World Is Money and Power
กลโกงโลกพนัน
description:
Geon-U Dan has vowed to overthrow the status quo of the dysfunctional high school he recently transferred to, where rich and powerful third-generation chaebol heirs call the shots and gambling runs rampant. But does Geon-U have what it takes to beat the odds, defeat the Taekyeong Oh Family, and restore law and order to his high school?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Notes:

- Includes one extra chapter.

- Belongs to Blue String universe.

By day Bo-Ram Eom is a secretary, but by night she’s secretly a children’s storybook author under the pen name Bo-Ram. Too talented to be just an office worker, she created The Child with A Mask to escape her terrible boss, Se-Hu Kwon. Sure, he’s attractive, intelligent, but he’s also super rude! And now, he wants to find the creator of the book. How long can she keep her identity secret? And why does her boss want to meet her…

(Source: Tapas, edited)

title.english: Saving the Villain from the Heroine

synonyms: Saving the Villain Who was Abandoned by the Female Lead
Methods to Save the Villain Who Was Abandoned by the Heroine
สาวใช้อย่างข้าจะช่วยตัวร้ายเอง!
ヒロインに捨てられた悪党を助ける方法
description:
Sielle is an ordinary handmaid working for the Grand Duke Ferzei Yekarte.
The thing is… she knows he's a villain of a story she read in her previous life on Earth.
With her prescience, she managed to foil an assassination attempt on her master, only to be framed for the crime!
Worse yet, when she drank the poisoned wine to prove her innocence, she turns into a little girl...
And now the Grand Duke wants to ship her off to a notorious family of assassins?

Will she manage to survive through all this, even if she knows how it will all end?"

(Source: Pocket Comics)

synonyms: ยูมยองจะเป็นซุป’ตาร์
description:
“I’m an unknown actress who cleans houses as a side gig. Ironically, my name means fame.” Struggling actress Myeong stumbles upon a photo exhibition filled with photos of her younger self, when she was filled with hope. Can she become a star as this mysterious photographer’s muse?

 (Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

characters.description: The main protagonist, and a struggling actor with a cleaning side job. Unbeknownst to her, Myeong was the muse of the photographer Eunmil, who is now declared dead. As his muse, she was called 明 (myeong). This launches her into worldwide fame, giving her the opportunity to be cast in her first significant role.
Myeong’s manager.
Myeong's younger colleague who has become a star actress. The two used to have an amicable relationship, but now she schemes against Myeong.

Myeong's boyfriend at the start of the story, and an aspiring director. In college, they promised each other that Myeong will star in Hyeonjae's directorial debut. Hyeonjae is very focused on his work and fulfilling their promise, to the point that he and Myeong grow distant.
[Myeong's](https://anilist.co/character/322911/Myeong-Yu) Father
[Myeong's](https://anilist.co/character/322911/Myeong-Yu) school friend. He wanted to be a cartoonist, but now he is a devoted father of two and runs a convenience store.
The director of Metaphor Entertainment.
The lead actor of Arcadia, [Cheon-Jin's](https://anilist.co/character/361569/CheonJin) first work and first love.
[Myeong's](https://anilist.co/character/322911/Myeong-Yu) Mother

synonyms: 最強の隠しクラス＜サポーター＞
description:
Lee Seohyun is the #1-ranked player in the long-forgotten game "Asura Online." As he wonders why no one plays anymore, he stumbles upon the hottest new game, "Asrian Online." Based on the world of Asura, with similar maps and characters, becoming the best in Asrian should be a piece of cake. But after he picks his hidden class, he learns he has become a puny supporting character. Though Seohyun has his sights set on becoming a star again, the only way to the top this time will be as a supporter!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

In a world where the smallest offense warrants the death penalty, Burner’s plan was to keep her head down and get the hell out of Area 5. But after reaching her breaking point, she suddenly finds herself a wanted criminal at odds with the Central Bureau and its most powerful Admin, Great. As she begins to discover her own powers and gain new allies, all-out war breaks out between the government and the revolution. Will a rag-tag team of rebels be enough to win the fight to define justice?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: (Flashback), 18 (pre time skip), 21 (post time skip) Race: Human Eye Color: Orange Birthday: October 12, Relatives: Pound (Adoptive Father) Berry (Adoptive Mother) ~! Jin Bear (Father) Morgan Bear (Brother) Great (Brother) !~ Affiliations: ~! XEVOLTZ Black Bloods (Leader) !~ Occupation: Street Fighter (Formerly) Revolutionary ----------------------------------------------------- Initially, Burner was like any regular citizen in Block 5, poor, homeless, and living in constant fear of Great. Dreaming of one day leaving Block 5 and living a better life, she endured abuse from the rich for money and ran from any sign of trouble. However, after a child she saved from an anteater is killed by Great and fighting him as a result, Burner's personality changes. All the rage, sorrow, and aggression she built up during her life made Burner become a more daring, short tempered, and confident person. Resolving to defeat Great instead dying pathetically, she joins the XEVOLZ in order to become stronger and find her father. As a child Burner was like a normal kid, happy, liked stuffed animals, and enjoyed spending time with her parents. However, even as child Burner knew violence, and due to her father's training she wasn't afraid to use it when necessary. Burner was taught martial arts by her father Pound, who is considered the strongest martial artist of his time. Her style is based on accelerating to target vitals, and uses a particular stance that bring her a half-step closer than other martial artists. It also appears that her martial art focuses mostly of punches for attacking. ~! After training with XEVOLTZ Burner learned how to ignite her fists in blue flames like her father. !~ Techniques ~! Rapid: A lethal move where Burner charges at her opponent with such speed it creates a shockwave behind her, and punches her opponent before they can react. Primary Ignition Burst: A lethal move and Burner's most powerful attack. The move performed with Burner's fist glowing before performing a punch that releases a massive blue explosion. Burner has stated that this technique was more attuned to her Father Pound as only his body could properly withstand it. Single Blow - Truth: A single focused punch that is strong enough to knock Drian in one strike. Secondary Ignition: In effort to make her own style with the Blue Blossom, Burner created this ability. She activates it by dragging her left hand up her right arm, and then ignites both of her arms. Transcendant Rapid: An improved verion of Burner's Rapid technique, which she can use after activating "Secondary Ignition." It allows her to move so fast that Drian's Mentor and Joy of the 4 Gatekeepers got stuck by it before they could even react. Even the Robert of the 3 Sword Saints lost sight of her when she used this technique. Burning Claw: After activating "Second Ignition" Burner can shape the flames of three claws with two X-shaped dots in the center. With her speed, she uses this technique to land incredibly fast punches on her opponent before they can react. Using this technique Burner was able to completely overwhelm Joy. It can be combined with Burner's Truth technique to make for a far more powerful attack. !~ Red Eye State ~! Upon discovering her mother's death Burner entered a state of uncontrollable rage, where her eyes glow red and all her abilities were greatly amplified. The energy she gave off in this state was said to be on the same level as Great's, who is able use this ability as well. It has been stated this state is achieved through extreme excitement. When Burner entered this state she became so powerful that she was able to overpower not only one of the 3 Sword Saints but also Pound. There are drawbacks to this technique however, the first being she cannot discern friend from foe, attacking anyone she views as a threat. The other drawback is that it causes Burner internal injuries due to her using power beyond her physical capabilities. !~

Great is the administrator of block 5 and a sword saint that hold one of the 3 great swords, "Black Blood". Great has a extremely radicalized view of how the law should be upheld and practised. Because of this ideology Great kills everyone indescriminetaly that breaks the law regardless of its severity, and for such actions is seen as a demon by some. Great and Burner regard each other as enemies after their first encounter.

Young leader of revolutionary group XEVOLTZ. He runs the group with the Raison d'etre of not killing anyone under any cirsumstance, as he believes that is the only way to change Graymark for the better. His Authority ability allows him to bend others to his will at the cost of a lot of stamina.
The swordsman of revolutionary group XEVOLTZ. One of the , making him among the strongest swordsmen in the world. He wears a mask during battle.

Former Vatican Battle Priest, current member of the revolutionary group XEVOLTZ. He has the appearance of a humanoid dog, causing him to feel like an outcast. He wields a large cross made of multiple firearms in battle.

Chief Medical Officer of revolutionary group XEVOLTZ. She has a strong desire to keep anyone on either side of the revolution from getting hurt, hence her still keeping her position as a government doctor while she moonlights as a XEVOLTZ operative.
Engineer of the revolutionary group XEVOLTZ specializing in robotics and all kinds of technology. He is quite short, and has a very large nose and equally impressive moustache.

synonyms: I Will Divorce My Tyrant Husband
Je divorce de mon mari le tyran
description:
Im Jeong-A used to be an ordinary grad student living in South Korea. After reading the novel “The Flower From Another World,” late into the night, she wakes up as Empress Robellia Le Castilla, the wife of the tyrant Alexandros the second. Though Jeong-A had felt sorry for Robellia while reading the novel, she never wanted to become her. Alas, Jeong-A must accept her new reality and find a way to divorce her husband. At first, she thinks this will be easy, as the emperor is always cold toward Robellia and only expresses affection to his consort in the novel. However, every act of trying to get Alexandros to agree to a divorce piques his curiosity instead. Will Jeong-A succeed at getting the happy, solo life she wished for Robellia to have?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

title.english: The Main Characters That Only I Know

synonyms: The Main Characters That Only I Know
description:
“If I were given another chance...”

10 years after the apocalypse began on Earth, while he faced imminent death, Yoohyun was filled with regret. Just then, a bright light descended upon him. When he opened his eyes, he was greeted by an unfamiliar scene. Not only had he reincarnated as a non-human race called “Teller,” but he had also traveled back in time by 10 years!

“Now that it has come to this, I’ll live my best life this time! ”

Unlike his previous life, where he was solely focused on survival, he is now determined to lead a successful life. In this new life he has gained, will Yoohyun truly be able to become the protagonist?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: Trash Belongs in the Trash Can!

description:
Woo-Bin is an expert at seducing rich ladies with his handsome looks, and lives off of the gifts he receives from them. He approaches the rich, beautiful Su-Ji to prey on her... but ends up falling in love! Blinded by love, Woo-Bin doesn't realize that Su-Ji isn't the angel he thought she was, but rather has a dark side that slowly entangles him. Each with clearly different intentions, Woo-Bin and Su-Ji fall into a romance that can't be recycled!

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)
