Quản Gia Nam Phụ Của Tiểu Thư Xuyên Không
ภารกิจพิทักษ์พ่อบ้านสุดหล่อ
description:
Woori is heartbroken when she finds out that her favorite character Lancelot dies tragically in the novel "The Flower Raised her Sword." She knows too well that the butler suffered from his one-sided love for the heroine Charlotte and even gave his life to avenge her death. So when Woori wakes up in Charlotte's body, she's determined to steer sweet Lancelot away from his miserable fate. But with the original Charlotte making a reappearance, as well as the villainous Duke Vestia, things might not be so simple after all. Can Woori guide Lancelot to his happy ending without revealing her true identity?

(Source: TappyToon)

synonyms: I Shall Live as a Prince
description:
When your average guy struggling through life in modern day Korea gets “reborn” as a grand prince in the Joseon Dynasty, it seems like a pretty sweet deal, right? Nope, not if you’re the younger brother of King Yeon-San, one of the most tyrannical kings in Joseon’s history. A reign of terror is imminent, and it’s only a matter of time before everything goes downhill. But with a new Grand Prince Jin-Seong taking matters into his own two hands, perhaps history won’t repeat itself…

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Stars Are on My Side

synonyms: I’m the Only One Loved by the Constellations!
ผมเป็นลูกรักของกลุ่มดาว
description:
After a catastrophe wipes out civilization, leaving only mysterious towers as humanity’s last refuge, those who are able to reach the higher levels are revered as “Astras.” Baek Homin is just a low-level lackey, but all that changes when he is tattooed with a skill-inducing circuit. Now, he has the power to recall the memories of his past incarnations… all three of whom happen to be Astras! As Homin sets out on a new adventure full of formidable foes, will the Astras be able to keep him safe?

(Source : Tapas)

The great house of the Azure Mountain Yeon clan was annihilated by forces that conspired against them. The only survivor was Yeon Hojung. Left alone in the uncaring expanse of the central plains, Hojung turned to the path of darkness for survival and ruthlessly chased power to become the Dark Emperor. After a long, bloody battle that ended in his demise, Hojung reawakens to find himself 26 years in the past with his beloved Yeon Clan and a second chance at life.

(Source: Tapas)

Seunghee may seem like a regular high school boy, but he’s got a few secrets: he loves to cross-dress and read BL comics. He’s looking for a match that will accept him, but it’s classmate Seungtaek who spies him on a date gone bad. Now that someone at school knows he’s gay, can Seunghee’s life remain ordinary the way he likes it?

(Source: Tappytoon)

synonyms: Born as the daughter of the wicked women
เมื่อฉันเกิดใหม่เป็นลูกสาวนางร้าย
description:
Born as the daughter of a villainess, Daphne lived her entire life hated by everyone she’s ever crossed paths with. After her mother’s pitiful death, Daphne knows that a similar fate awaits her-- but what did she ever do to deserve it? Why does she have to be branded as a wicked child when she’s done no wrong? In order to survive, Daphne will have to take her life into her own hands… but will she be able to make a name for herself, or will she be known as the villainess’s daughter forever?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: Originally from Korea, she was reborn as the daughter of the novel's Villainess.
A former assassin who befriends Daphne. He was the original heir to the Benedito family in the original novel.
The head of a merchant company and Daphne's adoptive mother.

A paladin from the temple who has unrequited feelings for Chloe. He's also the grand duke of the Clemence Kingdom and the uncle of its crown prince, Simon. He initially assumes Daphne is his unacquainted child whom Chloe had bore in secret due to the girl having similar gold eyes and white hair to him and Chloe, respectively. Received the nickname "Crying Man" from the Benedito family from to his tendency to cry a lot.

synonyms: エンジェリックレディ
description:
My best friend betrayed me! Born from a low-ranking noble family, Angela grew to be renowned for her beauty and grace, becoming the prized angel of society, all with my enthusiastic support. Yet beneath that glitz and polish, she was simply... evil. She used me and had me killed out of sheer spite in her quest to become the empire’s greatest woman. But unlucky for her, a magical gift from a dragon has given me a second chance at life. No longer blinded by her light, I’ll do all I can to stop her!

(Source: Tapas)

What happens if you end up summoning the Dark Lord, the whole continent’s greatest enemy? Due to a battle that took place over a thousand years ago, cursed people become demon-like magicians, and those who are blessed become holy knights who protect the kingdom. Lapis, who hides her identity of being a magician and aspires to be a holy knight, accidentally ends up summoning the Dark Lord. Along with the Dark Lord’s puzzling confession, Lapis’ journey of becoming a holy knight begins!

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: A magician who hides her identity and infiltrates the Area Academy as an apprentice knight.
The Dark Lord who was accidentally released from her seal by Lapis and unintentionally confessed to by the latter.

title.english: The Holy Emperor's Grandson is a Necromancer

description:
After a near-death experience, something has changed about the Holy Emperor’s troublemaker of a grandson. To be precise, his body was taken over by a Korean man who died while playing a VR video game! But when his necromancer character is mixed with a Holy Prince’s blood, things start getting funky. The zombies he makes are incredibly nice, his curses start healing people, and the girl he saved from being turned into a zombie suddenly gains super strength. Now he has to play the hero, but he’d really rather just go for a nap.

(Source: WEBTOON)

synonyms: Lips on the Tip of a Knife
Les lèvres au bout de la lame
จุมพิตปลายคมดาบ
description:
Arnée Brillhit is the captain of the Golden Dragon Knights and one of the few swordmasters on the continent. As such, finding a man willing to marry Arnée in the Western Empire is like finding a needle in a haystack. So, when Grand Duke Cassian Ternuzen of the Northern Empire asks for Arnée’s hand in marriage, Arnée’s mother gladly gives him her blessing while keeping Arnée’s identity a secret. At first, Arnée is determined to get a divorce and return to her homeland, but she quickly finds out married life isn’t so bad, especially when her handsome husband treats her like a porcelain doll. Will Arnée be able to protect her marriage without revealing that she’s the notorious “mad dog” of the Western Empire?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Orphaned at birth and bullied at work, Myohee has been through countless trials in life. But when she gets scammed by her only friend and ends up bankrupt, Myohee feels as though she’ll never find the silver lining to her cloud. She decides to end her own life by jumping from a building, but mid-air, the grim reaper halts her descent, saying her time isn’t up yet. She’s ordered to live for 100 more days…as a cat! Before she knows it, she’s taken to the home of her handsome, aloof boss, Mr. Cha. It seems like the perfect chance to receive the love and care she never had in life…if only Myohee can remain a cat!

(Source: Lezhin US)

synonyms: เจ้าสาวราชามังกร
description:
Ten years ago, a young girl saved the life of a dragon. Little did they know that they would be brought together again by the vicissitudes of fate, when Lucina’s family estate is invaded by the fearsome Tayar nation led by King Hakan. After Lucina’s selfish stepmother offers her up as a bride to Hakan in exchange for their lives, Lucina realizes that she is now fated to journey to the arid kingdom of Tayar and marry its seemingly brutish king. Will fate lead the unlikely pair to ruin or romance?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: The Great King of Tayar.
The illegitimate child of Baron Berg.
Garrett's younger brother.
She's a fairy whom Lucina meets on her way to Tayar.
Queen Dowager of Tayar. Hakan's mother.
Lucina's maid.
Hakan's subordinate.
Former queen of Tayar.

title.english: The Evil Princess Dreams of a Gingerbread House

synonyms: The Villain Princess Wants to Live in a Confectionery Shop
The Villainous Princess Wants to Live in a Gingerbread House
The Villainous Princess Wants to Live in a Cookie House
The Villainous Princess Wants to Live in a Sweet Shop
The Villainous Princess Wants to Live in a Candy Store
องค์หญิงตัวร้ายขออยู่ในบ้านขนม
悪役皇女様はお菓子の家に住みたい
description:
Following her reincarnation into the body of a storybook princess, little Asya only wants one thing: to bake lots of sweet and delectable desserts! Of course, her family is the poorest of the poor, but she’s willing to do whatever it takes to protect her dream and live a peaceful life surrounded by cookies. Unfortunately for her, Asya realizes that she is actually the malevolent Princess Anastasia, a girl who was blessed by a great and powerful spirit, whose hubris brings about her own miserable destruction. But where there’s a will, there’s a way, and Asya isn’t above using her childish charms and excellent baking skills to secure her safety! Plus, what could possibly go wrong when she has the mighty Spirit of Sensation at her side?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Woo-Hyun is rich, good-looking and popular… but he also happens to be a total bully. His punching bag is Ha-Yan, a stuttering and amenable girl in his class. Woo-Hyun likes nothing more than harassing her… The weird thing is, Ha-Yan actually seems to crave his attention, feeding off it. As they each spin a web of deceit to ensnare the other, who will end up getting caught? And could romance bloom from this tangled, thorny mass of obsession?

(Source: Lezhin US)

synonyms: チトラ〜イケメンをガチャする伯爵〜
La vie virtuelle de Chitra et son majordome
Chitra: Ikemen wo Gacha suru Hakushaku
description:
I spent years preparing for the civil service exam.

But I can’t believe I died so unfairly…!

Is that so?

I was reborn as a beautiful countess.

I even got the ability to play games from the God of Beauty.

‘Drawing…?’

Yes, I have the ability to draw out characters.

I have become the apostle of the God of Beauty and benefited the world widely by drawing out ultra rare characters.

[Rare-!]

[Super Duper Ultra Special Rare-!!!]

Let’s fill the world with handsome men to benefit all the women!

(Source: Original Publisher, translated)

synonyms: ไอ้โง่ผู้ยิ่งใหญ่
description:
Do good or go to hell. The conditions of his new curse seem simple enough for once-hopeful hoodlum Jeon-Ji Kim. Or so it seems when his perky guardian angel shows up on his doorstep one day and heals his limp. But will simply going through the motions of helping people be enough to appease a petty god with a grudge?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

characters.description: The main protagonist of Flawed Almighty, a former hoodlum given the resolution to do good or go to hell. Guided by his guardian angel he goes through the motions of helping people to appease a petty god with a grudge.
Occupation: Teacher

title.english: The Back Alley Mage's Second Life

synonyms: Return of the Back Alley Wizard
description:
Once a loyal hound to a powerful magic family, Aster was used, betrayed, and killed. But death wasn’t the end—it was a second chance. Back in the back alleys of his youth, Aster now holds the future’s secrets in his hands. This time, he won’t serve anyone. Can a man who once served power learn to become his own master?

(Source: WEBTOON)

synonyms: Second Life on the Red Carpet
description:
The first time Vedis transmigrated into the novel “Princess of Eventide,” she followed the original plot exactly for seven straight years—and lost almost everyone she loved along the way. Lucky for her, she’s been sent back to the start again along with her close friend Rosanne, the princess of Moselberg. Together, they will do everything in their power to prevent the violent rebellion and save the people they love. But when they start making different choices, what else will change? And will they discover the traitors in time?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Got Dropped into a Ghost Story, Still Gotta Work

synonyms: Got Dropped into a Ghost Story, Still Gotta Work
description:
I sacrificed my precious vacation to attend a pop-up event of a certain modern fantasy I loved so much. And on that very day, I got transported into that fantasy world. As none other than a newly hired employee at a renowned major corporation! A dream workplace with tons of benefits, a high salary, and kind, competent supervisors. Using my knowledge of the world, I quickly climb the corporate ladder!

But am I happy, you ask? Please, let me go back home.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

synonyms: ภารกิจรอดชีวิตของสาวใช้
メイドとして生き残ります
Guide de survie de la servante
description:
Ash Tolkayn was an ordinary office worker before she somehow became a maid in a BL novel with a scandalous love triangle between the King, his mysterious male lover, and the jilted Queen. But everything changes when the King appoints Ash as the crown prince’s new nanny… after murdering the previous one! Now, on top of juggling the duties of childcare, she finds herself smack dab in the middle of the cutthroat royal drama. Can Ash rise to the challenge and survive as a maid?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: Born and raised in South Korea. While cooking ramen at home, she suddenly wakes up as a maid, during the birth of a prince. Ash has no memories of her current body's past, let alone her own name. All she knows is that the Queen she serves will come to a bad end, and the palace she works in is prone to death if she doesn't act well. Ash isn't described as being particularly eye catching, though her personality is quite charming. She doesn't feel any particular alliances nor is she attached to children, but she is diligent and works hard / dutifully with what she is given.
Yurigel is lovely in every way with a gentle and loving heart. Despite being a commoner, every male character in the story falls in love with him, particularly the King.

A talented Swordsman who is assigned as the baby Prince's bodyguard. In the Novel "The Escape", Mio loves Yurigel one sidedly, to the point he would whisper brainwashing words to the baby at night, turning the prince against his mother the Queen. In the current timeline, he is a stoic and stuffy young man. Although always disagreeable, he seems to get dragged along by Ash's whims. He's also quite thoughtful and tender sometimes, though his actions are often dismissed by Ash who knows he is still in love with Yurigel.

Duke Capella, the current Swordmaster and the one and only good friend of King Evans. Unlike most characters in the novel world, Klein seems to really dislike Yurigel. He was against going to war, even if he would reluctantly lead it, and returned in failure.

A grand mage who suffers from severe PTSD. His desertion during the war causes it to end in failure. He is still allowed to bless the baby prince at the banquet and has been skulking about in the Library ever since. ~!In the Novel "The Escape", his PTSD is soothed by Yurigel and he falls in love, becoming a great boon to him. Ash approaches him first to avoid this, only to almost die from strangulation after triggering him from his sleep. She eventually uses this incident to persuade him into sleeping in her room with Mio, as the mage cannot sleep without hearing the sound of the living breathing.!~ Ciel is described as having a similar demeanor to Yurigel, and really loves children. He brightens up completely around Prince Mikael but his aggressive PTSD causes Ash to feel concerned.

The primary love interest in the novel. Despite his marriage to the queen, his love for Yurigel is met with fanfare and unanimous agreement throughout the land. He is incredibly protective of Yurigel and extremely handsome.

description:
With Kang Dol's crush on Yang Yang growing larger and larger, he decides to confess his feelings. With his back turned against her, he makes a courageous confession. But when he opens his eyes and turns around, instead of Yang Yang, he finds Min Dosim standing in front of him. Oops?! But the more shocking twist is that Dosim, the school's most popular girl, mistakenly obliges and they decide to go out! What is Kang Dol supposed to do to fix this mess?

(Source: Lezhin)

characters.description: Min Dosim's best friend and Kang Dol's crush.

title.english: The Returned C-Rank Tank Won't Die!

description:
Betrayed by her team and abandoned to die in a dungeon, timid C-rank hunter Cho-i Hyeon discovers a cursed ring that keeps her alive by endlessly regenerating her body. Time stretches into years as she’s killed over and over, unable to escape. When she finally does, she’s no longer the girl who was left behind. Stronger, colder, and haunted by something growing inside her, she wants answers -- and revenge. But the ring may have a will of its own, and its true cost is only beginning to surface. Whatever it is, it may already be too late to stop.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

synonyms: ราชาแห่งโซโล่เพลเยอร์
description:
Betrayed by his guild and defeated by a top player, Hyrkan loses everything. Before he can get revenge, a fatal accident ends his life—only for him to wake up years in the past, back at the start of Warlord. Now, with his memories intact, he’s determined to rise to the top alone. But in a game where power means everything, can he truly survive without any allies? The Emperor of Solo Play is back, and this time, he’s playing by his own rules.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Single with no regular job, Go Nanhee starts a new cleaning gig and meets Oh Deokhoo; literally the filthiest, NERDIEST guy she's ever seen! If that wasn't bad enough, his uber expensive action figure goes missing during her shift! Now she’s stuck cleaning his messy apartment in order to pay him back. Can a man who’s only ever seen a girl in games and a woman who only fawns over stars on TV… actually fall in love?

(Source: Tappytoon)

characters.description: Deok-hoo is a programmer and CEO of a gaming company. He is somewhat shy and awkward when it comes to communicating with people. He is also obsessed with nerd culture and can get carried away when talking about his passions.

A hard-working employee, she began working at Joyple part-time after failing her civil servant exam for the fifth time. Now that she's thirty though, she's determined that it's now or never and her sixth attempt will be her last go at it!

description:
In a French town wracked by fear, Rose Dupré is bullied as a witch's daughter. Marie and Pierre don't believe such rumors at first. But when a wave of strange deaths sweeps in, the three children are no longer safe from wary eyes. Can Rose survive the curse of magic and suspicion? An expansive yet colorful gothic tale begins.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes 27 non-numbered chapters counting season prologues, multiple-part episodes, extra chapters, side stories, and an epilogue.

characters.description: The main protagonist of the webtoon, she is described as being always lonely and a girl who cries often. She is the daughter of Léa Dupré.
The best friend of Rose Dupré.
Peter's older brother. He's about 20 years old.
Mother of Rose. She's kind, tender and beautiful like a noblewoman. Some people say she's a witch.

title.english: I Became the Chef of the Dragon King

synonyms: I Became the Chef of the Dragon King
The Dragon King and His Chef
มื้อนี้แด่ราชามังกร
description: Cheong Shim (a.k.a Cheongi (Cheong-i)) threw herself into the sea of Indangsu! What will happen when she wakes up in a lazy dragon's dungeon? Meet many cute monsters while living a delicious, symbiotic life!

title.english: I Became the Mother of the Evil Male Lead

synonyms: I Became the Mother of the Bloody Male Lead
ฉันกลายเป็นแม่พระเอกนิยายจอมเสเพล
Je suis la mère du anti-héros
description:
The newly reincarnated Sheriel learns she has become the mother of Karthizel Roperam, the male lead of a dark romance fantasy novel. All the neglect Karthizel faces as a child leads him to become a crazy and obsessive man who’s willing to kill anyone to get what he wants, even his own mother! Then the only way for Sheriel to keep herself alive in this timeline is to have him be raised right under loving parents, which means she’ll also need to make amends with her cold, estranged husband. Will Sheriel be able to save herself and this broken family?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

title.english: Regression of the Yong Clan Heir

description:
Hwalin Yong, once the shattered heir of a fallen martial sect, is thrust back in time-- but he isn’t alone. A monstrous darkness lingers at the edges of his mind, constantly whispering, waiting to claim him. Can Hwalin resist its pull, or will he surrender to the shadow? As the battle within intensifies, he uncovers a dormant power that could reshape his destiny and the fate of his sect.

(Source: WEBTOON)

synonyms: La ley de supervivencia de la señorita
description:
“Please let me take over someone else’s body this time!” That was my request to the King of the Underworld upon my latest arrival. None of my previous incarnations made it past my 25th birthday, so the king promised that if I succeeded, he’ll grant me a long, healthy life. I asked for an existence filled with wealth and physical prowess that had no siblings and no complications with men… At least he fulfilled the first three! My name’s Lukina. Title: the Duke’s daughter. And my goal: survive past the age of 25!

(Source: Tapas)

Sanghyeon has the uncanny ability to absorb powers of magical artifacts—by devouring them. But it took him thirty years to master, and at fifty-five, it’s too late to escape mediocrity. Then one day, he’s miraculously sent back in time to the fateful day he awakened his powers as a monster-hunting player. With a chance for a do-over, he wastes no time using his ability to its full potential, rapidly absorbing incredible powers and rising through the ranks, determined to become the hero he always dreamed of being.

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: She's one of the top players in the country, known as Shadow Assassin.

synonyms: The Shadowed Legacy of the Soulless Messenger
description:
Azadin, a member of the cursed Messenger Clan, is born with the worst of curses. Lacking magical prowess, he becomes the lowest-ranking messenger, wandering the continent collecting gold coins in hopes of breaking his curse. But when his twin uncovers a great conspiracy, how will he face the impending doom?

(Source: Manta)

A master elementalist, Egret lived his entire life in the company of elemental spirits, having felt shunned by human society for his immense power. After his death, he is reborn as the young prince Judas, a social outcast bullied for his quietness and small frame. With his trusty spirits by his side, Egret enters the elite academy Ruvar-H, where he must make friends and turn Judas’ reputation around. But with danger from his past life following him, can this great sage make it in the real world?

(Source: Tapas)

Jung Erae has no clue about relationships and men to the point where she drives every man away. Desperate, she seeks help and ends up contacting a love doctor, Cha Yoon. Strangely enough, Erae starts developing newfound feelings for this so-called doctor.

(Source: Lezhin)

characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm Jeong I-Rae is a second year student on the Department of Economics at Seoyeon University. She is very insensitive when it comes to relationships, so she is often misunderstood by her male students without even realizing it. In order to solve her problems related to romantic relationships with the opposite sex, she decides to get her relationship tutoring from [Cha-Yun](https://anilist.co/character/324795).

__Height:__ 171 cm Graduated from the Academy of Dance and Arts Management. She is a self-proclaimed doctor of love, and takes on the role of [Jeong I-re](https://anilist.co/character/324794/IRae-Jeong)'s love tutoring.

synonyms: I Don't Want to Be Duke's Adopted Daughter-In-Law
สะใภ้อุปถัมภ์คนนี้ขอเตรียมตัวบาย
description:
When an accident shows Ellie what bullying the male lead, Damian, would do to her in the future, she tries to stay away from him at all costs. But after seeing everyone else mistreat the poor boy, she decides to protect him until he meets Duke Schuetz, his future adoptive father. However, there's one thing Ellie doesn't expect when she helps them reunite: the duke's offer to bring her with them as his daughter-in-law! How will this new plot twist change her fate and the course of the story?

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: การแสดงออกของนักรักฝึกหัด
description: Jae-Won has known that he likes males since he confessed his feelings to a boy named Yoon-Sung in elementary school, but when Yoon-Sung tells him that liking other boys is weird, Jae-Won tries to hide his "weird" feelings and push them away. Now in high school, he's developed a strong crush on his kind, handsome classmate Ka-Ram, and Jae-Won decides it's time to finally confront the reality that he might be gay. He asks for advice over the internet and befriends another gay student named Jun-Seo, who becomes Jae-Won's emotional support in his quest to win Ka-Ram's heart.

characters.description: Hair color: Black Eye color: Brown Jun-Seo and Jae-Won first got to know each other on internet as anonymous. After Jae-Won found him out in the same school and same grade, they become closer little by little. Jun-Seo is in second year class 7. Doesn't seem to have many friends. Pretty smart, but has a rude way to behave. He can't handle compliments well and gets embarrassed when anyone calls him handsome. He has a poor eye sight. Though he wears contact lens in school, he is seen wearing glasses in home.

Hair color: Red Eye color: Dark brown Was a class president and friend of Jae-Won in Elementary level. He's Jae-Won first crush. Though he moved to another place in elementary, he came back to the same neighbourhood in High school in the middle of second year. Has an elder sister. Yoon-Sung is smart, handsome and liked by almost everyone. He is full of himself though he is actually right about it. Apparently, he is the tallest among all characters in the manhwa.

The class president. According to Jae-Won, she has an innocent and nice personality, and is kinda popular among guys. She's childhood friends with Ka-Ram. She seems to be very strong and skilled in martial arts. Really likes popcorn.

title.english: The Villainess Becomes the Leading Lady

synonyms: Even Though I’m the Villainess, I’ll Become the Heroine!
description:
Reborn into a fantasy novel as a wicked character fated to meet an early demise, Minjoo - now Dahlia Margaret - has a lot on her plate right from the start. But at least she’s now free of her vicious high school bully, Sooyeon. Or is she? When Dahlia meets Flore, her estranged sister and the protagonist of the novel, she is shocked to find that the girl bears a suspicious resemblance to the classmate who tormented her. Now, driven by the desire to save her own life and also get revenge, Dahlia needs to make a powerful ally, and she has her eye on a handsome royal who just might be perfect for the job. However, a deal with this mysterious man might mean more than she bargained for...

(Source: Tappytoon)

One day, a mysterious virus spreads through the city of Seoul in the form of mutant cells that keep multiplying. When people come into contact with these cells, they turn into hideous and dripping creatures that can infect others at any time.

Yeon-U, who is on a school trip to Seoul, is excited at the thought of getting closer to So-Yeon, a classmate whom he had a crush on. But for Yeon-U and his classmates, the trip soon turns into a nightmare. In order to survive, these high school students must find a way to escape the city before it is completely engulfed by the virus.

Ma-Ru Kang was just an ordinary kid with ordinary interests, until one day his father forces him to watch a soccer game on TV, sparking an obsession with the sport. Filled with determination, he sets a new goal for himself -- to become an amazing soccer player! The only problem is, he has already been proclaimed the “King of the Losers” at his high school. Can Ma-Ru overcome the obstacles in his path and transform into a talented and successful soccer player?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

characters.description: Football player. He wasn't always interested in football, but when he was in 5th year of primary school, he watched a documentary on the 2002 Korea-Japan World Cup with his father, and he got into football every since. Ma-Ru is hard-working and never skips a day of practice. His pass and technique are described as being very good.

description:
One day, a gate suddenly opened in the heavens, bringing with it the invasion of monsters and the intervention of monks in the human world.

『Miracle Drug “Coffee” Administration』

『Medicinal Contents: Caffeine and Sugar』

☞ Provides energy

☞ Stimulates the central nervous system

☞ Maximizes senses and reflexes

The whole world appeared to slow down, and Han-Yul’s medications began to show its true effects.

synonyms: I Became a Legendary Archmage by Reading a Book
description:
300 years. That was how long it had been since he had last been opened. For 3 whole centuries, the mysterious book of magic, also known as Grimoire, has been stuck on the shelf of the Le Temis Royal Academy Library. Just then, an apprentice mage opens the Grimoire, only to die in a freak accident. As the dismayed Grimoire awaits his teleportation to a new location, the library door creeps open and a mysterious girl, Riley, approaches and opens the Grimoire, becoming his new contractor.

(Source: WEBTOON)

synonyms: The Devious Daughter of the Duchy
description:
Estelle, the empire's saint, was an illegitimate child who tried her best to be loved by her family and fiancé... until they sacrificed her to a demon for the sake of their greed. After 600 years of being tortured, she makes a deal with the demon to return by possessing the body of Jewel de Garnet, the only child of a powerful noble family. With her new identity and fierce determination, will Estelle successfully carry out her revenge? Or will someone from her past stop her from doing so?

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: The Omniscient Point of View of an Unrequited Love
description:
Hye-Ji is a famous SNS star with over 100,000 Instagram followers. Due to her popularity, Hye-Ji has received many confessions, but despite that, she doesn't really have much dating experience. One day, Hye-Ji received an invitation to go out on a date with another popular SNS star whom she secretly admired. On the day of the long-awaited date, Hye-Ji couldn't stand the subtle light coming from the karaoke bar, so she decides to use her feet to take a selfie. But due to an accident, Gi-Seong, who was a part-timer at that time, ended up seeing her in an embarrassing position.

After such a disastrous date, Hye-Ji decided to end her first-ever relationship. However, on her first day at school, she meets Hae-Ri, the person who gave her that embarrassing memory!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

synonyms: Duke's Eldest Son Is a Regressed Hero
Hero Becomes the Eldest Son of a Duke
The Hero Becomes Duke's Eldest Son
英雄、公爵家の長男になる
description:
No one understands why local lowlife Lord Aden Remes suddenly acts like the upright knight he was meant to be. The truth is, Aden's been possessed by Aden Albireo, the empire's hero who died after defeating the villainous Underlord and facing betrayal by his closest friends. Now, Aden's out to get revenge on those who killed him with the help of a few new allies and none other than the Underlord himself! Can Aden and his gang buckle down and power up? Or is the lord hero fated to fail once more?

(Source: Tapas)
Jeanne, a prostitute at address 74, took care of the fallen Janet. Jeanne wants to be friends with Janet, but Janet tries to get information out of her.

characters.description: Janet is cold, withdrawn, and works as an assassin.
Jeanne, a prostitute at address 74. She is one of the main characters of the story.

synonyms: เกิดใหม่ชาตินี้ เบบี๋ขอเป็นซุป'ตาร์
description:
After being reborn for the umpteenth time, 7-month-old Lee Seojun finally gets the chance to fulfill his original dream of becoming a superstar actor! Using magic abilities from his past lives, baby Seojun captivates his playmates and becomes an overnight sensation with a viral mukbang video that helps fussy kids eat. Soon, he's shooting a baby food commercial, and his uncle's entertainment company is knocking at his door... but will Seojun be able to keep up the magic to match the demand?

(Source: Tapas)

Commander Liza Mary of the Imperial Knights returns victorious to the Empire of Phaeton after a long war to subjugate an enemy kingdom. But little did she know that her beloved fiancé Illian would leave her for Flora, the princess of the fallen enemy kingdom… After drinking herself into a heartbroken stupor that night, Liza awakens to the modern world in the body of timid high-schooler, Do-Eun. Puzzled and confused, Liza seeks to find out what happened and return to her own world, aided by Do-Eun’s friends Ian and Lora, who look suspiciously like Illian and Flora!

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

characters.description: Ji-Hun is a free-spirited, playful, and extroverted transfer student from a rich family. He's in the teddy bear club with [Do-Eun](https://anilist.co/character/371238/DoEun-Yu), where he is one of the most skilled members at sewing. ~!He falls in love with [Liza Mary](https://anilist.co/character/371237/Liza-Mary) while she is in Do-Eun's body. Liza reciprocates his feelings, and the two of them date until she has to return to her world.!~

Liza is a strong and confident woman, the commander of the Imperial Knights, and the villainess in the webtoon that [Do-Eun](https://anilist.co/character/371238/DoEun-Yu) wrote. One day, she suddenly gets transported into Do-Eun's body in modern day South Korea.

Do-Eun is the author of the webtoon that [Liza Mary](https://anilist.co/character/371237/Liza-Mary) is from. She's a timid and insecure high school student with a passion for art. After wishing to escape from her life, Do-Eun locks herself away in her mindscape, and Liza is transported into her body.

I-An is [Do-Eun](https://anilist.co/character/371238/DoEun-Yu)'s closest childhood friend and the inspiration for her webtoon character Illian Friedel. He is a kindhearted, friendly, and supportive person who won't hesitate to go above and beyond to help his friends.
Do-Hyeon is [Do-Eun](https://anilist.co/character/371238/DoEun-Yu)'s younger brother.

Min-A is [Do-Eun](https://anilist.co/character/371238/DoEun-Yu)'s classmate and fan of her webtoon. Her favorite character is [Liza Mary](https://anilist.co/character/371237/Liza-Mary). ~!She is the first person that Liza confides in about her situation and true identity. They become close friends, and Min-A helps her try to find a way back to her world.!~

Lo-Ra is [Do-Eun](https://anilist.co/character/371238/DoEun-Yu) and [I-An](https://anilist.co/character/371241/IAn-Jeong)'s childhood friend and the inspiration for the character Flora in Do-Eun's webtoon. She's in the cheerleading club.
I-Sak is [Do-Eun](https://anilist.co/character/371238/DoEun-Yu)'s ex-friend, as well as the inspiration for her webtoon character [Liza Mary](https://anilist.co/character/371237/Liza-Mary).

title.english: Beloved by the Male Lead's Nephew

synonyms: The Male Lead's Nephew Loves Me So Much
หลานพระเอกสุดแสนจะปลื้มฉัน
description:
After being reborn as a stalker villainess destined to die for trying to kill Archduke Calix Elluiden's lover, Charlize Lienta fled from the capital to stay away from the archduke at all costs. But her plan goes awry when she returns a year later and rescues a poor boy on the streets... because he turns out to be Sasha, Calix's long-lost nephew! Given her infamous reputation as Calix's stalker, will Charlize succeed in returning Sasha without raising the archduke's suspicions?

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: The Genius Tamer of The Academy
アカデミーの天才テイマーになりました
description:
Shunned as the weird kid at school, Han Siha wakes up one morning to find he is not quite himself anymore. Instead, a former vet intern who died from overworking has taken over Siha's body! But this story isn't like the novel he read in the "real world." With status windows popping up, feisty dragon partners, and classmates meant to be his future enemies, Siha is unsure if his skills are up to snuff. Will this mage make it to graduation? Or will he find that this story has an abrupt ending?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Return of Elena the Knight

description:
Elena Blaise grew up as a count’s daughter in a royalist household backing Crown Prince Carlisle. The prince’s sudden assassination makes way for the Anti-King Paveluc, who annihilates House Blaise overnight. As the sole survivor, Elena trains as a knight to avenge her family. When she finally faces off with Paveluc, a deadly blow not only knocks her unconscious but also catapults her into the past! Elena wakes up one year before the fall of House Blaise. Determined to protect her kin, she rushes to save Crown Prince Carlisle, asking for his hand in marriage and offering her services as his knight. Bewildered as he is, Carlisle takes the bait. The future now lies in the hands of his fiancée fighting on his behalf!

(Source: Tappytoon)

synonyms: 落ちこぼれ魔法使いは力で無双する
description:
Sensing shifts in mana, successfully manifesting it, and attending the most prestigious school at the top of his class at a young age, Ruin Ardell is on track to become a great mage. Everything was going smoothly until he discovered that he had a condition preventing him from expelling mana. Ruin’s tumble from grace gave those jealous of him the opportunity to toy with him. But in the depths of his despair, he discovers a miracle in the form of a system message.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes one extra chapter.

synonyms: Beneath the Surviving Princess' Joyful Façade
Ce qui se cache derrière son sourire
เบื้องหลังรอยยิ้มของเจ้าหญิง
description:
When the king offers Aerik Cladinae his own sister's hand in marriage for his meritorious deeds in battle, he didn't expect to get saddled with a limping, drooling woman like Miesa Esquillre. Driven insane by her brother's physical and psychological torture, Miesa rolls around on the ground, spills food all over herself, and screams unintelligibly as a way of communicating. But sometimes, Aerik catches a flash of shrewd understanding behind those vacant eyes. Is Miesa truly as mad as everyone thinks... or is she hiding something?

(Source: WEBTOON)

synonyms: ฉันเลี้ยงดูคู่หมั้นด้วยเงินค่ะ
description:
Money can’t buy her love, but it can help her get sweet, sweet revenge. Take a seat at Lady Ilya Bloden’s table and watch Ilya charm her way out of a loveless engagement, help the “Bloodthirsty Butcher of the Battlefield’' find the courage to speak to the manager, and single-handedly destroy one of the most influential families in the Ishtar Empire. Tea and crumpets will be served!

(Source: Tapas)

Ju-Won Lee works as a doppelganger who poses as a hero’s alter-ego, and fills in for them in their social life while they perform their duties as heroes. One day, Justice, the strongest hero, approaches Ju-Won and requests his services with the promise of a hefty payment in return for his work. However, when Ju-Won arrives at their meeting spot, he is instead greeted by a completely unexpected sight...

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

A Catholic school where everything seems tranquil and fine. But for Ayeon, a day doesn't pass without getting bullied until one day, Yeonhwa steps in against the bullies. Ayeon is grateful for Yeonhwa but what she doesn't realize is that there seems to be something more than just good intentions behind that beautiful smile.

(Source: Lezhin US)

characters.description: Bullies Ayeon. Is very short.
Dahye's older sister.

synonyms: I Only Came to Find My Dad
I Just Wanted to Find My Father
Why Did You Come To My House?
ฉันแค่มาเพื่อตามหาพ่อ
description:
The cruel chains of destiny threaten to condemn Louise to a life of slavery. Benjamin, an evil man obsessed with her mother even after her tragic death, takes Louise into his custody, intent on marrying her. Louise tries to escape this horrid fate and awakens eight years in the past. She’s set on making things right but is unable to stop tragedy once again. Determined to not give up, Louise embarks on a journey to find her father. What discoveries await her in this fight for freedom? Will her father be the key to her happiness... or her demise?

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: A Divorced Evil Lady Bakes Cakes
A Divorced Wicked Woman Bakes Cake
離婚した悪女はケーキを焼く
离婚的恶女专注烤蛋糕
description:
After nine miserable years of marriage, Erin de Brissia is thrilled when her husband, Duke Raymond Von Lebensberg, accuses her of infidelity as an excuse to be with his own lover. After signing the divorce papers, she uses the recipes from her late mother to open a dessert cafe and receives rave reviews. But when her ex-husband and his lover get wind of this, they’re set on sabotage. Will Erin ever be able to taste the sweetness of success, or is this divorcée doomed to disaster?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes two extras.

title.english: A Ranker's Guide to the Good Life

synonyms: The Ranker's Guide to Live an Ordinary Life
A Guide to the Right Life for Rankers
คู่มือการใช้ชีวิตให้ถูกต้องสำหรับแรงเกอร์
ランカーのための正しい生活ガイド
description:
In a world filled with towers, dungeons, and monsters, some people have awakened with special powers. While these hunters risk their lives in battle and climb the world rankings, Jio Gyeon is happy to just sit back and enjoy a simple life of leisure. But Jio has a secret—she’s the strongest hunter in the world. But when a time traveling stranger warns her of humanity’s bleak future, will Jio finally take action? And what enemies are waiting for her to reveal her true identity?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Lord Baby Runs a Romance Fantasy With Cash

synonyms: คุณหนูคนนี้ผจญโลกโรแมนซ์แฟนตาซีด้วยแคช
代幣女孩勇闖奇幻世界
description:
Romance fantasies were my happy little refuge. I’ve read countless novels and left tons of top comments in RF forums, and where did that lead me? To getting hit by a reincarnation truck! Now I’m stuck in a zero-star rated story fighting for my life! My father, the vile Duke Phaeraton, abandoned me. I’m barely surviving, no thanks to my thieving uncle, Marquess Tarenka. I’m not even the heroine of this novel! But what’s this? “QUEST COMPLETE. ABILITY ACTIVATED.” Is this my ticket out of here?

(Source: Tapas)

This is not your typical invasion story. Gigantic oxygen-doped bees are attempting to dominate the human race by reversing the food chain. Lee is a middle-manager at a large company who has only one thing on his mind: save his family from the bug-apocalypse.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Beautiful and intelligent, So-Myeong Gil has tirelessly strived to fulfill her mother's vision of the perfect daughter. However, when her less-than-perfect younger brother is tragically found drowned in a river, doubts plague So-Myeong's heart. She begins to suspect that their mother might be responsible for the unspeakable act. From then on, her paramount goal becomes escaping her mother's grasp, while all her mother wants is for So-Myeong to experience the perfect life she herself was denied. Will So-Myeong ever truly find her freedom?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

synonyms: あいつのマネージャー
description:
Chansol never experienced friendship before he met Park Hanhoo, a troubled boy who terrifies school gangs and hides his face with an unruly haircut. But when a horrific event turns Chansol's world upside down, he is forced into hiding and reneges on his promise to stay by Hanhoo's side. Now an adult, he’s back to resolve old issues, but with the truth about his past hidden behind a world of mafia bosses and shady business, his only option is to infiltrate it as the manager of an unhinged arms dealer. As Chansol sets out to coax information out of his new boss, he realizes that seducing this handsome maniac may just bring him closer to the truth and the friend he used to call Park Hanhoo.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue

title.english: Surviving in a Romance Fantasy Novel

synonyms: Surviving in a Romance Fantasy Novel
description:
I, Seo Tae-Pyung, ended up transmigrating as the younger brother of the heroine in the fantasy romance novel Celestial Love. As romantic as this place is supposed to be, I was too busy just trying to adapt to my new life. Romance? Yeah, right. My goal was to keep a low profile and live quietly… But then… “How could you make the crown princess fall for you of all people?!” At that point, I had no idea. I was only just beginning to scrape the surface of this bizarre turn of events…

(Source: Kakao Page, translated)

synonyms: หัวใจที่ปลายหนาม
description:
After touring America in an attempt to start a new life, Hui-Su boards a plane back to her homeland of Korea. She soon realizes that it is not so easy to escape her unfortunate destiny when the plane spirals out of control and she is warped to a strange world that is distant from Earth and full of zombie-like creatures called “maenok.” Luckily enough, she is unintentionally rescued from a dire situation by an elegant and refined gentleman named Calix Clovis, who possesses the mysterious ability to wield a blue flame that can kill the maenok. He is a chaste paladin who has sworn his body to the Church, but Hui-Su quickly notices his physical reaction to her naturally seductive charms. Will she succeed in surviving by using her feminine wiles to win over Calix’s heart and body?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

I've become a big, hairy beast!

After getting into a car accident, Hanbyul wakes up in the body of a princess. But something's wrong; she's doubled in size, grown hair everywhere, and seems to terrify everyone who looks her way — she's become a beast! How will she live on as the cursed Princess Alexa?

(Source: Manta)

characters.description: Second princess of Felipe Kingdom. During the war with Ephil Empire her accomplishments were significant that without her the war would be lost. She's a war hero. She's got incredible strength as well posses great sword fighting abilities. Because her curse people named her Alexa de Beast.
Grand Duke everyone's afraid of. He's not very sociable and thinks everyone despise him. He's very skilled at fighting while using a sword.
Captain of the Royal knights order.
The first princess of Felipe Kingdom. She's Alexa's older sister and she's trying to make Alexa's life more complicated.

description:
The year is 203X, and Earth is under attack. The enemy? Extraterrestrials. Park Hyunsung, a militia commander, valiantly lays down his life to take down the enemy base. One moment, he’s caught up in a malfunctioning teleportation device; the next… he’s in the body of Ian Alberon, a 15-year-old lord! Thrown into a world of monsters and magic, Hyunsung — now Ian — must figure out how to navigate his new surroundings. And to top it all off, it seems his enemies may be much closer than he thinks…

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: A Saint Who Was Adopted by the Grand Duke
นักบุญหญิงผู้ถูกตระกูลแกรนด์ดยุกรับเลี้ยง
description:
After being abused, tortured, and exploited by her best friend Lavienne for 14 lifetimes, Saint Dinah swears to get revenge. And luckily for her, she manages to capture the attention of Archduke Tersia, who adopts and renames her "Esther" to honor his late wife's wishes. With her new status and knowledge of Lavienne's true nature, Esther embarks on the long journey toward vengeance. But will she succeed? Or will her 15th life meet its demise due to Lavienne's greed?

(Source: Tapas)

Ian is seemingly the perfect student – kind, trustworthy, and handsome to boot, he became known as “the Angel of Christmas” thanks to an innocent act of kindness from when he was a child. So when Yugun returns to school after an extended sick leave, no one is surprised when Ian is there to help him get through the day. Thanks to Ian’s cherubic persona, Yugun thinks he can trust him - that is, until he overhears a conversation between the boy and his mother that reveals it was all a plan to maintain Ian’s image. Incensed at the betrayal, Yugun confronts Ian and threatens to reveal his true colors to everyone. However, Ian’s unexpected response confuses Yugun even more: “Go ahead. But whatever happens after is not my responsibility.” After all, who could hate the supposed “Angel of Christmas?” Will the two remain like oil and water? Or will they learn to blend together to create something more beautiful than either of them could have ever imagined?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.

A senior disciple from a countryside martial academy returns as the world’s best! Dragged into a brutal political war, senior disciple ‘Hyeok Musang’ didn’t return after the bloody war ended. No one knew whether he was still alive for 5 years.

Upon barely returning to his hometown, he found his Dragon Tiger Martial Academy being persecuted and destroyed by a third-rate gang.

He thought he could live peacefully with his fellow members after winning the war but seeing the miserable state of his master and fellow disciples, he was filled with anger and guilt.

With the return of the senior disciple, everyone thought things would get better but only for a moment. Things were still happening in his hometown of Yangzhou County. Was the war really over? The head disciple raises his sword against the dangers threatening his Dragon Tiger Martial Academy.

No one would have ever guessed that nerdy-looking Seongbin Cha is actually Neon Mask, the internet hero popular for punishing violent, bullying teens on ViewTube. He won’t rest until he eradicates every last delinquent in the country. Can he stomp them all out with the help of his bodyguards, or will they come back stronger than ever?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Bookworm - Soo-Hyuk. Reading fun number one, always looking for a new way to read books. Even joined new game  so no one could disturb him from reading books. The moment Soo-Hyuk finished reading his first book and closed it, he received notification: Wisdom +1 level...

title.english: The Hero, the Demon, and the Villain

synonyms: Hero x Demon King x Villain
description:
The three arts of swordsmanship are all that swordsmen seek to master in this world. Eager to learn, some will take dangerous paths, others will trick, and some will even kill. Serena R. Lavail, a possible hero, is one of those who seek to master the arts to save her family. To do so, she embarks on a mission that starts right in the enemy's lair. There she meets the villain, Kane S. Ronald, who has a mysterious past and a mysterious lost skill. Heroes, villains, foes, and friends... what will be the fate of these two?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Reborn Prodigy of the Ducal Family

synonyms: The Unprecedented Prodigy of the Duke's House
description:
Once the commander-in-chief of Earth’s resistance and a legendary monster hunter, Han-Seong was dragged into another world and enslaved by the Empire through a binding spell. For ten long years, he fought their wars, crushed their enemies, and was discarded like a weapon. But death wasn’t his end. Revived by the Stone of Reincarnation, he awakens as Dale, the heir to a powerful ducal house. With unmatched brilliance and a burning desire for revenge, Han-Seong begins his second life to destroy the Empire that once enslaved him.

(Source: WEBTOON)

synonyms: There's Something Wrong With My Popularity
我的人气肯定出现了问题
Wo De Renqi Kending Chuxian le Wenti
description:
Si-Won Cha is obsessed with his popularity. Having transformed everything from his weight to his demeanor to remake himself into the perfect popular guy, he loves being the center of attention. What happens when he is challenged by over-eager and equally narcissistic rival Da-Un Hyeong? And why does Da-Un somehow think Si-Won has a crush on him?!

(Source: Manta)

Ye-Sul Hong has a secret – when she kisses someone, she can see flashes of their future. It’s hard to believe she’s ever met the right guy when she can’t even see herself in their destiny. She doesn’t get much use out of her ability until one day, when she accidentally kisses her evil boss, Min-Hu Cha, who’s got a secret of his own. To her utter shock, she sees a vision of herself… in bed with him! As if that’s not confusing enough, she shows up to work the next day to find out that her first love has been hired to work in her department. Will she be able to survive working with the man she wished had been her destiny and the man she’s destined to be with?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

synonyms: The Villainess Is Shy in Receiving Affection
The Villainess Is Shy to Be Loved
สาวน้อยตัวร้ายชักรู้สึกเขินอายที่ได้รับความรัก
description:
When Melody discovers she's a villainess in someone else's story, being a slave dealer's daughter only adds to her guilty conscience. After her mother kidnaps Loretta, Duke Baldwin's long-lost child, Melody tries to comfort the scared little girl and forms a sisterly bond with her. So when the duke finds them, he takes both of them home because now they're inseparable! As the rest of House Baldwin becomes enamored with Melody's warm heart, will she ever learn that she deserves to be loved too?

(Source: Tapas)
With no savings, average qualifications, and a bank balance consistently below 10,000 won, can the Backbone Breaker Gye Baeksun really escape unemployment?

title.english: My BFF is a Tyrant in Training

synonyms: I Raised My Childhood Friend as a Tyrant
ฉันเลี้ยงเพื่อนสมัยเด็กให้กลายเป็นทรราช
J’ai élevé mon ami d’enfance comme un tyran
description:
A young Korean woman is reincarnated inside a novel as Viche Amelian, who according to the story, is to be executed in place of the young prince Jade for assassinating the emperor. After facing her death, she expects to get her old life back, but instead wakes up as a 10-year-old Viche! Could it be that her death failed to turn Jade into a tyrant, as the story foretold? Viche must now figure out where she went wrong, and make sure that this time, Jade becomes the world’s most wicked tyrant!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

An illegitimate daughter of Emperor Berthold Amaryllis of Visio, Ludis has spent her entire life being mistreated and pushed into the shadows. Now, with the Visio Empire standing on the precipice of destruction under the threat of Demonspawn hordes, her father finds a new use for her in becoming the sacrifice necessary to summon an ancient god. But as the colossal golden eyes seem ready to consume her, she finds herself in the embrace of a mysterious man...

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

title.english: Writing My Male Lead's Happily Ever After

synonyms: I Will Take Responsibility for the Welfare of the Male Lead
主人公の幸せ、私が責任を取ります
ฉันจะดูแลคุณพระเอกเองค่ะ
男主角的幸福就包在我身上
description:
A madman with a tragic childhood and a disease that brings on insanity, destined to fall obsessively in love with the saintess of the holy nation… This was the male lead of the melodramatic novel I wrote. He is also the very person who kills Laria Sherwood, the villainess I possessed, and whom I must stay away from to survive… or so I thought, until I saw the terrible reality I created. I suppose, as the author, it wouldn’t hurt to teach him how to love, then leave right when the female lead appears, right? But will it be as easy as I thought?

(Source: Tapas)

Garam has always loved to draw, but his dreams of being an artist have been on hold ever since his mother passed away. Wanting to become more independent and focus on his art, he moves into his grandmother's empty house by the ocean. There, he meets his greatest muse: a mystical water creature with no memories of her past. Now it’s up to Garam to help her uncover what she has forgotten.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

characters.description: Myst is a mystical creature who is awakened by Ga-Ram. She has no memories of who or what she is, or where she came from. With the help of Ga-Ram, she learns the ways of humans, while also searching for her memories.

Ga-Ram is an artist whose dreams are put on hold after his mother passes away due to a long-term illness when he was a child. He was then taken in by his mother's friend, where he grows up with his adopted parents and adopted brother, who treat him as their own. As an adult, Ga-Ram decides to move out of his adoptive family's home, believing he has been a burden on them for far too long and that he wants to become independent. His adoptive father, however, strikes a deal with him. Worried that he does not have enough money to afford his own place, he allows Ga-Ram to live at his mother's home (Ga-Ram's adoptive grandmother's) in the countryside as long as he promises to keep it clean and care for the home while he is there.

Yu-Ri Lee is a childhood friend of Garam's. The two, along with Garam's adoptive brother, would attend the same schools before Lee moved in middle school, though the three would reunite once again in high school.

synonyms: My Body Has Been Possessed by Someone
description:
Seven years ago, Kanna was thrown into the body of a Korean girl named Ju-Hwa. She had everything in her new life—a loving family, a great boyfriend, a hard-won medical license, even her own clinic! But that all changes when she's suddenly swapped back one day. Just as she's been in Ju-Hwa's body, Ju-Hwa has been in hers... and she's left Kanna's life a mess! First things first, she's going to divorce her cold husband, Duke Silvian Valentino. After that? Revenge on everyone who's wronged her.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

title.english: I Got Pregnant with the Tyrant's Child

synonyms: I Gave Birth to the Tyrant's Child
description:
For Elan the royal knight, the masquerade festival is a rare chance to let loose and relax. But her night of fun quickly turns into a morning of horror when she wakes up beside the ruthless Emperor Kylart. Knowing how cruel he can be to clingy women, Elan makes a run for it, hoping he hasn't seen past her disguise. But as she continues her nerve-wracking duties of guarding the emperor, she starts experiencing troubling health symptoms. A trip to the doctor reveals that she's pregnant! To make matters worse, rumor has it that Kylart is looking for the mysterious woman he met on the night of the festival. Can Elan keep her secret safe from the entire palace, when she can't even control her constant cravings and morning sickness?

(Source: Tappytoon)

On the night of a full moon, Do-Gyeong runs into a vampire with blood dripping from the corners of his mouth. Haunted by the encounter, he tries to dismiss it as a dream...but not only does the vampire go to the same school as him, he begins following him around everywhere! Do-Gyeong is horrified of course, but as time passes, he discovers some peculiar quirks about the creature: he prefers his meat well done, flinches at the sight of cats, and loves to cuddle. Who is this mysterious vampire, and why is he so fixated on Do-Gyeong?

(Source: Lezhin, edited)

title.english: You’re the Only One I Can See

synonyms: You’re the Only One I Can See
description:
Following the advice of his imaginary friend Jason, who told him, "Treat all girls like stones," Park Jin-yong starts seeing every girl as a stone. But then Sunwoo, a female student who doesn’t look like a stone, appears before him, and for the first time in five years, the sight of a girl’s face sends Jinyong’s happy little circuits into overdrive...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Kang Eun-Joo loses both her house and job at the same time. When she discovers a working position at a mansion, she immediately grabs the chance! How will her life as a live-in caretaker in a mansion play out, with a rude employer she immediately butts heads with?

A story of unusual people in an unusual mansion!

characters.description: The main heroine. She is outspoken and straightforward and interested in fashion and books.
Rude, straightforward and anti-social house owner. He works as a writer.

description:
Love is the new kid on the block when he runs into the Peach Club, the local gang. Simple and gentle, with an interest in sex toys, Love isn't looking for trouble. Too bad the gang's got plans for him. And so does their leader, Peach.

(Source: Lezhin)

I can help you kill your friends.

Strange dungeons have started appearing all over the world and wreaking havoc. I-Seon, a guy with the power to rebuild cities, witnesses his friends being turned into the undead. Hyeon, a powerful hunter, comes to him with an interesting proposition. I-Seon has no choice but to accept his offer.

(Source: Manta)

characters.description: __Height:__ 178.5 cm
__Height:__ 187 cm

synonyms: The World Without My Sister Who Everyone Loved
The World Where the Beloved Sister Disappeared
description:
After being taken in by the noble house of Nacht, Sienna grew up with her adopted sister, Lorena, who she believed to be the sweetest, kindest person in the world. But after Lorena attempts to kill her, Sienna realizes how much her "loving" sister actually hated her. She tries to end her life with a magic potion but ends up going back in time instead. Determined to survive, she tries to use her memories to her advantage. For some strange reason though... Lorena is now nowhere to be found.

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: จักรพรรดิเย็นชา ย้อนเวลาหารัก
description:
Only after Empress Lizzie died did Emperor Leon realize his foolishness and regretted  it too late, but the time had already passed.

With Leon's wishes, the Witch of the Clock Tower turned back time to the day Leon first met Empress Lizzie, and all Leon had to do, after returning to the past, was to make Lizzie happy.

But the influence of turning back time was greater than he thought. Will Leon be able to make a happy ending with Lizzie this time?

(Source: Naver, translated)

After two decades of battling extradimensional monsters and protecting the world, Dae-in Lim is finally ready to retire and enjoy a peaceful life. However, the morning after his retirement party, he wakes up to find himself back in time… before he even gained his powers. Armed with knowledge of the future, Dae-in is determined to secure his fortune and retire again, but this time within three years.

(Source: WEBTOON)

As an illegitimate princess, Anastasia Entimos has died in just about every way imaginable. Every time she dies, she is brought back to the moment of her birth and forced to relive her tragic fate. It is only in her 10th life that she discovers her father is the esteemed knight and war hero, Paeon Parschel! Determined to escape her miserable fate once and for all, Anastasia vows to use her aloof father as a stepping stone to freedom. Will the 10th time be the charm for this ill-fated princess?

(Source: Tapas)

Lee Kang-Jin has just inherited an entire building in the affluent Gangnam neighborhood of Seoul. The only catch is he has to run the diner in that building for five years, but little does he know that he has to serve ghosts too! From 11 p.m. to 1 a.m., ghosts who carry resentment in their hearts come flocking to the diner in search of their comfort foods that remind them of what life was like. Can Kang-Jin handle both the culinary and personal demands of his undead customers for five whole years?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

As the illegitimate daughter of Duke McKellion, Lilian was never fully embraced by her father or society. So, when she has the opportunity to take her sister’s place in an arranged marriage to Emperor Kael Lu Kaldorf, Lilian jumps at the chance. The only problem is, her prospective partner gets cranky without his sleep, and since being cursed by a vindictive witch, the tyrannical emperor hasn’t experienced a single moment of slumber. But that’s no challenge for Lilian, who possesses the ability to induce sleep with a kiss. Now, tasked with the duty of keeping His Majesty well-rested, Lilian must kiss the emperor each night to keep his temper at bay. It’s a simple contractual agreement, and Lilian has no plans to develop romantic feelings, but what happens when Kael unexpectedly falls for her?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Witness the corruption of reason and divinity. Escape the nine hells of Fog Land. Driven by his conviction that everyone deserves education, science teacher Dante Kang agrees to teach in Fog Land, a mysterious international prison that houses the world’s most notorious criminals. But his very first class gets interrupted by a violent prison riot, after which, he finds himself in the cell of his mysterious captor. Dante must now travel through the nine circles of hell and escape Fog Land.

(Source: WEBTOON)

synonyms: 神之塔外傳：烏雷克·馬奇努
อูเร็ค มาซิโน่
description:
You know him as the legendary Ranker, Urek Mazino—but once, he was just another Regular, climbing the Tower alongside both teammates and enemies. What awaits him after charging into the Tower, chasing after Phantaminum? Whatever it is he desires... will he find it there?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: __Species:__ Human __Born:__ Outside __Height:__ 195 cm __Rank:__ Irregular, High Ranker #4 (Currently) __Position:__ Fisherman __Occupation:__ Wolhaiksong (Vice Captain) Urek Mazino is an Irregular, currently 4th in Rank. He was the strongest active Ranker before [Jahad](https://anilist.co/character/126030/Jahad) became active once again. He is also the most recent person to be part of the Top 5 High Rankers inside the Tower. He is considered to be on the same level as Phantaminum by weaker Rankers, however, his true rank is almost impossible to determine in terms of the Top 4 ranks because the top 2 Rankers are inactive and thus, cannot be compared with Urek. He mentioned to [Bam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/TwentyFifth-Bam) on the 43rd Floor that they would meet again later on the 77th Floor, then left the floor. His current location is unknown. Urek is said to have a ruthless personality, leading him to be respected by all those who dare call themselves men and at the same time seems to be disliked by seemingly every woman he meets. He is also shown to be extremely confident to the point of arrogance, often ridiculing the efforts of those who were no match for him. Despite his ruthlessness and boastful nature, he still wants to help others and friends in need. He will also help strangers if he thinks they are "worthy" to be helped. He respects one's courage, determination, and nobility.

Headon is the Guardian of the First Floor and is the caretaker of the Tower. He has an appearance reminiscent of a white rabbit because of his long ears. Headon talks in a friendly tone, but has been shown to have a cruel and manipulative streak. He presents his ideas and opinions in a logical and pragmatic manner, but his goals and desires themselves are not understood. He is perfectly willing to manipulate dozens of lives and create the nucleus of civil unrest to attain his mysterious goal. Although most Administrators normally stay on their Floors, Headon seems to be the only Administrator with the ability to visit other Floors of the Tower. It is said that Headon is the most experienced Administrator of the Tower. Although that only means he was the first Administrator Zahard met and therefore the first one to carry out the roles of a Administrator, that doesn't mean he's the oldest.

Eduahn is a High Ranker, currently in the 6th ranking. He is the head of the Khun Family, one of the 10 Great Families, and also the father of numerous children from the Khun Family, such as Aguero Agnis.

Khun Maschenny Jahad is a Top 100 High Rankers in the Tower from the Khun Family and the owner of the Yellow May, one of the 13 Month Series. She is the only Jahad's Princesses in the Khun Family to be awarded with a 13 Months. She is a direct descendant of Khun Edahn and Khun Maschenny.

Phantaminum is a mysterious and highly dangerous Irregular, currently __1st in the ranking__. He is famous for contributing to the creation of the stereotype against Irregulars. He is presumably the most powerful entity in the Tower and is actually an Axis. As the "Riddle", he is the most puzzling entity in the Tower: no clear motives, no clear relationships. Before entering The Tower, he was a guardian of order made by The Darkness in order to subdue beings of light called The 'Shining Ones'. After defeating them and sealing each Shining One into jewels, he defied The Darkness and ruled over all living creatures in the world, calling himself "The King of Jewels".

__Species:__ Human __Rank:__ High Ranker __Position:__ Spear Bearer Khun Marco Asensio is a High Rankers of the Khun Family. He is one of the direct sons of [Khun Eduan](https://anilist.co/character/135471/Eduahn-Khun). ~!__Data Asensio__ is an artificial character, a young version of High-Ranker Khun Marco Asensio back when he was still a Regular. It was created by the Hidden Floor system after the real Asensio finished all Hell Express test to save his data.!~

An enigmatic Princess of Zahard that started climbing the Tower at the same time as Urek Mazino. While her mysterious abilities and beautiful appearance spark everyone's curiosity, nothing is known about her, not even her name, except that she has a unique ability.
Mago is one of the original Shining Ones that existed Outside the Tower.

description:
How to avoid an execution!

After being murdered, Yeonwoo is reincarnated into her colleague's novel as Tara Elias, the unremarkable 5th daughter of the Elias family. But the entire household is fated to meet a grisly end, and it's not long before they're headed for the guillotine. Can Yeonwoo escape death this time around?

(Source: Manta)

What happens when the greatest martial artist of the Murim world meets a genius magician from a fantasy world?

(Source: Daum Webtoon, translated)

synonyms: แม่มดน้อยของนายทรราช
description:
Amelie Bourbon is a witch, destined to die at the hands of her lover, the ruthless tyrant Serwin Hennessia. So when ordinary office worker Lee Suyeon is reborn as Amelie, she vows to change the ill-fated story. The problem is the “calamity” sealed inside Serwin’s body, which threatens to ruin him and the entire world, can only be calmed when he is near Amelie. As she grows closer to Serwin, Amelie must hone her magic to subdue his violent impulses, but can she defeat calamity once and for all?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: I Can't Keep Up With My Stallion Duke

synonyms: 第二任老公太强了，好烦！
My Second Husband Is Desperate and Depressed
สามีคนใหม่ของฉันแซ่บเกินคาด
騙されて溺愛再婚しました!
description:
Not a single soul in Olivia Florence's life, including her own husband, provided the warmth that she craved, and she lived her life alone, growing strong.

Waking up two decades earlier right after her regretful arranged marriage to the Duke, Lord James Parnell, she plans to live a different life.

She hatches a plan to anull her marriage remarry the Duke, Ian Tyrone, infamous for being ""IMPOTENT"" for never showing any interest in the ladies.

Maybe his disinterest in women would allow Olivia to comfortably live as his wife, unburdened by childbirth and free of any other pressures in life.

But wait, the Duke who seemingly ""couldn't get it up"" turns out to be a complete stud at in the bedroom. What has Olivia gotten herself into?"

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Includes ten extra chapters.

Scholar Woon Hyun enters the palace after passing the Imperial Examination. Though he soon comes to lament his poor and miserable life of having to deal with the Crown Prince's hobbies, despite that, he doesn't give up and tries his best to learn martial arts. But Woon Hyun suddenly picks up his brush to conquer the Murim?! The hidden story of the scholar who passed the Imperial Examination at a young age begins.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

In 2018, monsters swarmed Seoul, and heroic “players” saved the city. Fast forward a decade, Hyukjin Kim, stuck in a seven-year rut after failing to become a player himself, gets a do-over. Zapped back to 2018, Hyukjin seizes his chance to rewrite history. With knowledge from the future and his re-awakened player talents, Hyukjin battles beasts and conquers dungeons in a pulse-pounding quest for redemption and survival!

(Source: Tapas)

A story of Yumi and her brain cells.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and an epilogue.

characters.description: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/yumiiii_0109/) An introverted girl who likes to eat. She likes Wook, but he turned her down. She got set up to go on a blind date with Wook's friend, Woong. Initially, she didn't like him, but after he rushes her to the hospital, she starts to take interest in him. They later break up after the topic of marriage comes up. Her cells wear a bright blue suit with a hood whereas her prime cell aka the love cell, wears a pink hood and cape along with a white suit.

synonyms: Kuro no Tsuki: Tsuki no Saidan (黒の月：月の祭壇)
DARK MOON: Altar de la Luna
DARK MOON: แท่นบูชาพระจันทร์
description:
Welcome to Riverfield, where the most popular boys at two rival schools happen to be vampires and werewolves. When a mysterious new student, Sooha, transfers to Riverfield, the rivals find themselves inexplicably drawn to her. As horrible incidents start to shake the town, the boys’ forgotten pasts slowly start to unravel… and their world turns upside down.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

characters.description: He is a vampire-werewolf hybrid in the tenth grade at Decelis Academy and a forward of the Nightball Team.
Heli is a vampire in the twelfth grade at Decelis Academy and the captain and center of the Nightball Team.
He is a vampire at Decelis Academy and the wing of the Nightball Team.
He is a vampire in the eleventh grade at Decelis Academy and a back of the Nightball Team.

Su-Ha is honest and expressive with her feelings. She hates vampires because of her superhuman strength she was constantly mistaken to be one, in consequence she repeatedly had to move to different cities. Also a vampire killed her only friend Chris.
Shion is a vampire in the tenth grade at Decelis Academy and a back of the Nightball Team.
He is a vampire in the twelfth grade at Decelis Academy and the enforcer of the Nightball Team.
He is a vampire at Decelis Academy and a forward of the Nightball Team.

description:
“Don’t ever, ever get involved with her.”

The warning Jeong Won receives is clear - stay away from Kim Jisoo at all costs. But the thing is, there’s just something so…intriguing about the other woman. Try as she might, Jeong Won can’t seem to tear her eyes away whenever Jisoo Is in the room. One night, Jeong Won misses the bus, and the only way to get home is the back of Jisoo’s motorcycle. It’s a thrilling ride, that’s for sure, but Jeong Won can’t say for certain whether it’s the rushing wind or the woman in front of her that’s making her heart race. As they get closer, Jisoo doesn’t seem like the bully she’s painted to be. Could the warnings have been a lie all along, or is Jeong Won in for the ride of her life…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

synonyms: คำสั่งเฉพาะกิจของท่านประธาน
description:
Soohyeon’s dreams of prosperity fall short of reality when he finds himself working as a secretary with an average salary. On top of that, his boss is Choi Jungwoo, nicknamed “Satan” due to her unyielding personality. One day, she requests something unexpected: she asks him to marry her. Just as he’s about to resign, she hands him a contract with conditions he can’t resist. If he marries her for one year, he’ll have all the money he needs to give his parents a better life. But… can he do it?

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: I Don't Want to Be Empress!
description:
Ever since being transported into the world of a book she read, Leana has had one goal: stay on the emperor's good side and avoid being sent to prison! Sure, she agreed to marry him and become his empress consort for a pampered life of luxury, but she's determined not to make the same mistakes as her antagonistic story character. But for some reason, things in the story keep changing -- new characters, unexpected events... Can Leana get this story back on track, or is she in for a plot-twist?

(Source: Tappytoon)

synonyms: จำเลยหัวใจ
description:
When the hand that used to so lovingly hold Annette Rozenberg ends up being the one that causes the downfall of her family, Annette demands that Heiner Waldemar give her a divorce. But Heiner refuses, stating that he must see her miserable by his side, no matter what. At odds, the two continue a precarious relationship, only to be met with wounds of the past that bring them tragically together.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

synonyms: The Chick Hunter Is Being Filial!
The Chick Class Hunter Is Being Filial!
description:
At 4, Groo is undoubtedly the youngest S-ranked awakened in the country. But as her kindergarten class's (self-proclaimed) ace, she can take a challenge! So when her first quest window tells her to find a grown-up who'll take her in, she marches down to the top guild in Korea and demands to be recruited. Sensing that this overpowered orphan shouldn't fall into the wrong hands, the guildmaster has no choice but to adopt her. But he has no idea this tiny girl is about to turn his life upside down!

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: 家族が私に執着します
My Family is Obsessed With Me
ครอบครัวนี้มีแต่คลั่งรัก
description:
The great hero Devota worked tirelessly to save the world from evil, only to be betrayed and killed by the very man who raised her. Luckily, she’s granted a new life as a young orphan named Diamond and, through a twist of fate, is taken in by an old comrade, now a powerful duchess. The whole family dotes on her like she’s one of their own, and as it turns out, she actually might be… But with her murderer still at large and her revenge still unfinished, will Dia be able to open her heart to love?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes a 20-chapter side story

"Devil, I don't want to marry him."

In hopes to escape a forced marriage, Giovinetta makes a wish to the devil to save her, but what she doesn't know are the consequences of her actions. Read the steamy story of a girl who just wants to be with the one man she is forbidden to love.

(Source: Manta)

characters.description: Giovinetta Iseult Eurycrates Valdemar is the protagonist of the series. She is the twin sister of Johannes Valdemar, the heir to the dukedom, and the older sister of Winfried Valdemar, a monk from Redempta.

title.english: Disobey the Duke if You Dare

synonyms: Désobéissez au duc si vous l'osez
description:
You must never see the duke’s face.

After her second husband's death, Lily is forced into a third marriage by her father. Her new husband is rumored to be a monstrous warmonger, but to Lily's surprise, the Duke turns out to be a kind man and husband. There's just one catch... she must never see his face.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Chapter count includes prologue.
